articleTitle: Nonlinear optical experiments on waveguide plasmon polaritons using 5 fs pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present improved experiments and theoretical modeling of the linear and third-harmonic optical response of particle plasmons coupled to a waveguide mode using 5 fs laser pulses, dispelling misconceptions of previous work by others.

articleTitle: Low reflection loss ion-beam sputtered negative dispersion mirrors with MCGTI structure for low pump threshold, compact femtosecond pulse lasers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Low reflection loss, ion-beam sputtered, multiple-cavity Gires-Tournois interferometer mirrors are used for dispersion compensation in different configurations of compact, low pump threshold, femtosecond pulse Cr:LiSAF and Ti:sapphire laser oscillators.

articleTitle: Performance of wavelength blockers in 80/spl times/10 Gb/s metro core add-drop network
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 5-node metro core DWDM ring with 80/spl times/10 Gb/s channels and 5/spl times/50 km SSMF fiber spans is demonstrated. Wavelength blocker based reconfigurable optical add/drop were used in the network and their performances were evaluated.

articleTitle: MSM-based integrated CMOS wavelength tunable optical receiver
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel MSM wavelength selective photodetector, integrated with its CMOS driver and receiver. We demonstrate /spl sim/1 ns wavelength switching access time for this receiver system.

articleTitle: Hyperchaotic breathers in semiconductor lasers with delayed electro-optical feedback
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that when subjected to delayed feedback, the output of semiconductor laser can display simultaneous fast-scale hyperchaos and small-scale periodicity. Experimental evidence of the phenomenon is presented.

articleTitle: Gold bowtie nanoantennas: improving the mismatch between light and nanoscale objects
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using two-photon-excited photoluminescence of Au, local intensity enhancement factors for Au "bowtie" nanoantennas have been experimentally determined for the first time. Enhancements >10/sup 3/ occur for 20 nm gap bowties, in good agreement with theoretical simulations.

articleTitle: Standoff sensing of natural gas leaks: evolution of the remote methane leak detector (RMLD)
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Development of a handheld standoff laser-based sensor developed specifically for inspection of municipal natural gas pipelines is described. The remote methane leak detector is fundamentally a Differential Absorption LIDAR system using wavelength modulation spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Pixel entanglement: experimental realization of optically entangled d=3 and d=6 qudits
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a method for creating entangled qudits using momentum and position entanglement in spontaneous parametric down-conversion. We image each photon onto an array of pixels, each representing one level of the qudit state.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion of 80 Gbit/s optical DQPSK using FWM in a highly non-linear fibre
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present, for the first time, wavelength conversion of 80 Gbit/s optical DQPSK. The wavelength conversion is achieved using FWM in a highly non-linear fibre. We demonstrate a conversion power penalty as low as 2.8 dB.

articleTitle: Sensitivity enhancement of electrooptic probing based on photonic downconversion by sideband management
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An electrooptic (EO) probing system based on photonic downconversion for multi-GHz signal measurement was successfully demonstrated. Sensitivity enhancement by controlling the ratio of carrier light to sidebands was investigated.

articleTitle: Advanced coding techniques for asynchronous fiber-optical CDMA
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We develop new coding methods for asynchronous optical CDMA systems with increased spectral efficiency and better BER performance. Furthermore, our approach allows random variations of the transmission rate, thus improving the physical level security.

articleTitle: Optical duobinary spectral efficiency versus transmission performance: is there a tradeoff?
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Tradeoffs between optical spectral efficiency, ASE noise-tolerance, and dispersion tolerance are investigated experimentally for three modulation formats - RZ, NRZ, and duobinary. Duobinary does not follow conventional wisdom - achieving excellent performance with the narrowest bandwidth.

articleTitle: Solitons in nonlinear media with infinite range of nonlocality: first observation of coherent elliptic solitons and vortex-ring solitons
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study solitons in highly-nonlocal nonlinear media for which far-away boundary conditions remotely control the evolution of the localized beam, and present the first experimental observation of coherent elliptic solitons and of vortex-ring solitons.

articleTitle: Integrated 1/spl times/4 wavelength-selective switch with on-chip MEMS micromirrors
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A monolithic 1/spl times/4 wavelength-selective switch is realized by integrating silicon planar lightwave circuits and MEMS micromirrors on silicon-on-insulator (1.4/spl times/2 cm/sup 2/) for CWDM networks with 20-nm spacing.

articleTitle: Quantitative Two-photon Flow Cytometry
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-photon excitation in conjunction with a suitable multi-dye labeling strategy enables quantitative flow cytometry under conditions of nonuniform flow, such as may be encountered in simple capillary flow or in vivo.

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg grating sensors for real-time health monitoring of aerospace vehicles
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Distributed fiber Bragg grating sensors are optically interrogated using a novel widely tunable semiconductor laser and an intensity-modulated reflectometry technique. This research impacts structural and environmental sensing for real-time health monitoring in space transportation systems.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh-speed polarization modulator
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Recent measurements on an ultrahigh-speed polarization modulator, capable of circumscribing a great circle on the Poincare sphere, are presented. Such a device, when fully packaged, has been demonstrated with a bandwidth of /spl sim/50 GHz.

articleTitle: All-optical NAND gate using cross gain modulation in semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By using gain nonlinearity characteristics of semiconductor optical amplifier, an all-optical NAND gate at 10 Gbps is demonstrated. The all-optical NAND gate operates in single mechanism, which is XGM.

articleTitle: Resolution of quantum and classical "ghost" imaging
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compare the accuracy of "ghost" imaging produced by separable and by entangled systems. Imaging is shown to reach its fundamental limit through the high spatial resolution and non-local behavior of entangled systems.

articleTitle: Slow and fast light propagation in erbium-doped fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study propagation of light pulses and modulation in an Er-doped fiber in the regimes of anomalously slow and superluminal group velocities. The pulses experience either delay or advancement depending on the pump power.

articleTitle: A wavelength selective switch with flat passband using a free-space grating and MEMS phase-shifters
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a 2/spl times/2 wavelength selective switch with 6.4 dB insertion loss and >25 dB extinction ratio. The folded Mach-Zehnder geometry, with a free-space grating and MEMS phase-shifters, enables fast independent control of multiple spectral regions.

articleTitle: Feedback control of linear quantum systems
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compare quantum and classical feedback control of linear systems, investigating the effect of back-action noise on control performance. One consequence is the existence of an optimal measurement for fixed system-environment coupling.

articleTitle: TE and TM guided modes in an air-waveguide with negative index material cladding
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that a planar waveguide with an air core and a negative index material cladding can support both transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) guided modes with low losses.

articleTitle: A multiterawatt laser using a high-contrast, optical parametric chirped-pulse preamplifier
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A laser has been built that uses optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification and a glass booster amplifier. We review the performance of the 5-Hz, multijoule OPCPA pump laser, the 370-mJ OPCPA, and the overall laser.

articleTitle: Nonlinear pulse propagation in dispersion-decreasing fiber studied with frequency-resolved optical gating
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate pulse propagation in a dispersion-decreasing fiber over a wide range of input powers both theoretically, and experimentally using frequency-resolved optical gating. Our simulations and experiments verify significant influence of Raman scattering on pulse propagation.

articleTitle: 25 GHz tunability of planar Bragg grating using liquid crystal cladding and electric field
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Application of a liquid crystal over a UV written planar silica waveguide provides the first electrically tunable, first order reflective Bragg grating using liquid crystals. 25 GHz tunability is achieved with a 25 Volt applied field.

articleTitle: Photoconductive terahertz antenna with radial symmetry
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The use of coaxial waveguides with terahertz pulses requires the difficult excitation of the radially polarized fundamental mode of the waveguide. We propose a radially symmetric terahertz antenna and present simulations predicting the generation of a radially polarized beam.

articleTitle: Duobinary-based CPFSK system with direct modulation to reduce the bandwidth requirement of the laser
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The duobinary concept is applied onto direct frequency modulation of a semiconductor laser to achieve a low cost high bit rate transmission with 50% reduced modulation bandwidth requirement.

articleTitle: Optical generation of linearly chirped microwave pulses using fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a new method to generate broad spectrum microwave pulses with an adjustable chirp, using an optical system based on two fiber Bragg gratings and a mode-locked fiber laser.

articleTitle: A compact 100-km FMCW fiber laser radar
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) measurements of Rayleigh back-scattering and Fresnel reflection from 95-km fiber have been demonstrated with a compact piezo-electrically-tuned sub-kilohertz-linewidth fiber laser. This is, to our knowledge, the longest distance measurement with FMCW.

articleTitle: Optical differential 16-ary Jones-vector shift keying
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The transceiver design of differential 16-ary Jones-vector-shift-keying (D16JSK) using multilevel detection is presented. The sensitivity of D16JSK is compared to that of polarization-division-multiplexed DQPSK. The transmission performance of D16JSK is studied by simulation.

articleTitle: Limits on the time delay induced by slow-light propagation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that there are no fundamental limits to the maximum time delay that can be achieved for pulses propagating through slow-light media, thus suggesting the importance of slow-light methods for practical applications.

articleTitle: Employing split-band technique and optical SSB filter at the receiving site to improve directly modulated fiber optical CATV system performances
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A directly modulated AM-VSB CATV EDFA-repeated system that uses split-band technique and optical single sideband (SSB) filter at the receiving site is proposed and demonstrated. Good performances of CNR, CSO and CTB were achieved for the full channel band over a-120 km single-mode fiber (SMF) transport. Our proposed system is suitable for the fiber optical CATV systems in long-haul transport.

articleTitle: Fs laser ablation of DAST
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High rate femtosecond laser ablation of the highly nonlinear active organic crystal DAST has been demonstrated. The threshold fluence and the ideal fluence range for damage free ablation at several wavelengths have been determined and the quality of the produced grooves has been investigated.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Suppression of Incoherent Interferometric Crosstalk with Dispersion Imbalanced Loop Mirror using Dispersion-Flattened High-Nonlinearity Photonic Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear suppression of incoherent interferometric crosstalk has been experimentally demonstrated with dispersion imbalanced loop mirror using the dispersion-flattened high-nonlinearity photonic crystal fiber. The signal quality improvement is achieved over a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: Mode add drop for optical interconnects based on adiabatic high order mode couplers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multimode multiplexing can replace WDM for implementing multichannel interchip interconnections. The operation, performance of a novel building block: mode add drop multiplexer is presented, based on adiabatic power transfer to high-order modes in silicon-on-insulator waveguides.

articleTitle: Self-assembled, ordered gold nanocrystal/silica thin films for prism-based surface plasmon resonance sensors
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Gold nanocrystal(NC)/silica films are synthesized through self-assembly of water-soluble gold nanocrystal micelles and silica by sol-gel processing. Absorption and transmission spectra show a strong surface plasmon resonance absorption peak at /spl sim/520 nm. Angular excitation spectra of surface plasmon show a steep dip in the reflectivity curve at /spl sim/65/spl deg/ depending on the thickness and refractive index of the gold NC/silica film. A potential SPR sensor with enhanced sensitivities can be realized based on these gold NC/silica films.

articleTitle: Mitigation of pattern dependency of all-optical logic XOR based on TOAD using pulse-position modulation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pulse-position modulation is for the first time introduced into all-optical logic XOR based on terahertz optical asymmetric demultiplexer. Simulation result at 40Gbit/s shows significant mitigation of pattern dependency. It is compared with ON-OFF keying modulation.

articleTitle: All-optical pulse compression and reshaping by spectral filtering from self-phase modulation in a nonlinear photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated all-optical pulse compression and reshaping by optical filtering from a self-phase modulation-broadened spectrum in a nonlinear photonic crystal fiber. A recirculating configuration is employed to increase the pulse compression efficiency.

articleTitle: Achievable information rates for high-speed long-haul optical transmission
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Achievable information rates for high-speed optical transmission (40 Gb/s and above) are calculated using finite-state machine approach with combined effect of ASE noise, Kerr nonlinearity (SPM, intrachannel FWM, intrachannel XPM), SRS, chromatic dispersion, and (optical/electrical) filtering.

articleTitle: Numerical study of slow light via stimulated Brillouin scattering in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study numerically Stokes pulse propagation in a continuous-wave-pumped Brillouin fiber amplifier. Time delay and pulse broadening of the Stokes pulse are studied in the small-signal and saturation regimes.

articleTitle: All-optical signal regeneration based on pump-modulated four-wave mixing in a nonlinear photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical signal regeneration has been demonstrated based on four-wave mixing in a nonlinear photonic crystal fiber. The output extinction-ratio is improved and a negative power penalty is obtained in a 10 Gb/s BER measurement.

articleTitle: Self focusing behavior in the fabrication of fiber Bragg gratings with an ultrafast laser and a phase mask
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Self-focusing behavior in the fabrication of fiber Bragg gratings with ultrafast lasers is observed. Self-focusing of two beam interference patterns generated by the phase mask is demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Frequency up-conversion at the single-photon level in a periodically-poled lithium-niobate waveguide
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using sum-frequency generation we fully up-convert signal photons at 1550 nm to 775 nm. Due to coupling and filtering losses at the output, overall quantum efficiency is /spl sime/3.4% with dark-count probability of 3%.

articleTitle: Towards Left-handed Metamaterials at Optical Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present metamaterials consisting of arrays of non-magnetic metallic split-rings with a magnetic resonance at 100 THz frequency. The magnetic response originates from coupling of the incident radiation to the LC resonance of the split-rings

articleTitle: Optimizing the design parameters for split-ring resonators at telecommunication wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss the influence of different sample parameters on the magnetic-resonance wavelength of split-ring resonators. Samples based on an optimized design are prepared via focused-ion-beam writing and show a resonance wavelength of 1.45 mum

articleTitle: Picosecond mid-infrared LIDAR system
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: With a picosecond mid-infrared LIDAR system based on a pulsed difference-frequency generation laser system concentrations of methane are measured in the plume of an aircraft engine.

articleTitle: Brillouin-zone spectroscopy of nonlinear photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel experimental technique for Brillouin-zone spectroscopy of photonic lattices with and without defects. Our technique facilitates mapping the borders of the extended Brillouin zones and the areas of normal and anomalous dispersion.

articleTitle: An optical fiber tip pressure sensor for medical applications
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An all fused silica based pressure sensor with a 125/spl mu/m diameter is presented. A Fabry-Perot interferometer is formed at the fiber tip. It offers biocompatibility, miniature size, high sensitivity, EMI immunity, and low cost.

articleTitle: All optical 2R regenerator based on induced phase modulation on an auxiliary carrier
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel all-optical Reshaper Regenerator is proposed. Reshaping and conversion behaviours in a multi-wave-mixing regime inside a particular dispersion-shifted fibre are induced on a third auxiliary carrier improving the conversion range.

articleTitle: Novel eye monitoring technique for detection of first order PMD
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new monitoring technique based on simple three-section eye-diagram sampling is proposed. It is used to identify and predict first order PMD and estimate the differential group delay. A high accuracy with error margin of <+/-10% was achieved.

articleTitle: Integrated a hybrid CATV/GPON transport system based on 1.31/1.49/1.55 μm WDM transceiver module
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We briefly demonstrate the three wavelengths WDM transceiver module with a pigtail fiber designed for GPON and CATV specifications. The discussion is addressed on duplex transmission measurement of gigabit-capable data and multi-channel video signal.

articleTitle: Laguerre-Gaussian beam generated with a multilevel spiral phase plate for high intensity laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed a multilevel spiral phase plate that generates a Laguerre-Gaussian beam by applying the wave surface of a spiral structure directly to a Gaussian beam for high intensity laser pulses

articleTitle: Observation of Monoenergetic Relativistic Electron Beams from Intense Laser - Plasma Interactions
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the observation of monoenergetic electron beams (dE/E<5%) produced by the interaction of a 12TW, 40fs laser pulse with underdense plasma, in contrast to all previous experiments, which produced energy spreads ~100%

articleTitle: All-fiber soliton source tunable over 500 nm
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a compact 200-fs all-fiber source tunable from 1050 nm to 1550 nm based on Raman effect in a highly nonlinear photonic-crystal-fiber that allows to completely bridge the spectral gap between erbium and ytterbium.

articleTitle: Electroluminescence from a single quantum dot at telecommunication wavelength
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have fabricated single quantum dot light emitting diodes and observed over 1.3/spl mu/m electroluminescence for the first time. The linewidth was less than 60/spl mu/eV and the intensity was increased linearly with current.

articleTitle: Gain-assisted nanoscale surface plasmons
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Surface plasmons at the interface between metal and dielectric with strong optical gain are analyzed. Proper choice of optical indices results in an infinitely large effective refractive index, vanishing low group velocity, and deep sub-wavelength localization near the interface.

articleTitle: Potential application of Periodically Aligned Liquid Crystal cell for projection displays
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transversely modulated nematic liquid crystal cell is suggested as an element of projection display. Equilibrium of the cell is studied and its optical performance is evaluated. High contrast ratio is predicted.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant quantum dynamical decoupling
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review our work concerning a method of decoherence control via concatenated dynamical decoupling (DD) pulses. These recursively nested DD pulse sequences exhibit a fault-tolerance threshold similar to that of concatenated quantum error correcting codes. We briefly discuss how quantum logic gates can be incorporated into this framework.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelop-phase stabilized 3.3-fs optical pulses in the monocycle region
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A system generating 3.3-fs optical pulses with a carrier-envelope-phase stabilized, quasi-monocycle waveform (500-nJ pulse energy, 470-to-1060 nm spectral width, 1-kHz repetition rate) has been developed for the first time

articleTitle: A single-photon resonant-cavity LED
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe an electrically driven single photon source consisting of a single InAs/GaAs quantum dot within a planar microcavity. Single photon emission from both the exciton and biexciton states is demonstrated under pulsed electrical injection.

articleTitle: Characterization of a cold atom gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper we will present the first study of a cold atom gyroscope. We will discuss the value of the present sensibility and the limitations of the setup.

articleTitle: Passively synchronized dual-wavelength Q-switched lasers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a simple and efficient way of generating synchronized Q-switched pulses at wavelengths hundreds of nanometers apart. This principle can result in new pulsed all-solid-state light sources at new wavelengths based on SFG.

articleTitle: Doubling the number of active users in a 2-D t-/spl lambda/ O-CDMA network using a hard limiting receiver
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We analytically show that using a receiver in a 2-D time-wavelength asynchronous O-CDMA system, can double the numbers of active users by reducing multiple-access-interference. Utilizing our results we generate design rules for O-CDMA code-sets in hard-limiting-receiver.

articleTitle: Purely phase-sampled fiber Bragg gratings for broadband dispersion and dispersion slope compensation based on the coupling coefficient chirp
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a purely phase-sampled Bragg grating for dispersion and dispersion slope compensation by introducing a chirp in the grating period and coupling coefficient. The bandwidth of all reflected channels can be equalized by chirping the sampling period and the coupling coefficient at the same time.

articleTitle: End-side pumped solar laser by a fused silica light guide assembly
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By a novel light guide assembly, the concentrated solar energy was efficiently transmitted and focused into an intense light column, uniform in flux distribution, within a Nd:YAG rod. Both beam quality and stability was improved.

articleTitle: InGaN/GaN MQW laser diodes with 4/sup th/ order FIB-etched gratings
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatially coherent vertical emission is demonstrated in an electrically pumped InGaN/GaN MQW laser with 4/sup th/ order surface gratings defined by Focused Ion Beam etching, with vertical output power 6 times above scattering background levels.

articleTitle: Lasing direction hysteresis in a semiconductor ring laser
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Wavelength and lasing direction hysteresis and dynamics in a semiconductor ring laser with varying current or temperature is explained as stemming from dissimilar nonlinear gain spectra in both propagation directions. Simulation results closely match experiment.

articleTitle: Metaphoric optical computing of fluid dynamics
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear optical propagation is recast in a comprehensive hydrodynamical formulation. The split-step method is proposed to combine optical devices as a configurable system that computes fluid dynamics, tremendously faster than even the fluid itself.

articleTitle: Information capacity of nonlinear fiber-optical systems
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We develop information-theoretical description of nonlinear optical communication systems. We present a non-perturbative calculation of the information capacity for different modulation formats, and demonstrate that fiber nonlinearity leads to exponential suppression of the channel capacity.

articleTitle: Probing and controlling electron spin coherence in GaAs quantum wells with three-pulse differential transmission
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed and used transient three-pulse differential absorption spectroscopy to probe and control the fifth order nonlinear optical response induced by electron spin coherence in GaAs quantum wells.

articleTitle: Two-photon interference with thermal light
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an experiment that extends the concept of two-photon probability amplitude to the general case of independent photons. The experiment also shows interesting practical applications regarding high resolution interference patterns with thermal sources.

articleTitle: Defect density dependence of thermal conductivity and temperature control of quasi-phase matching devices
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The thermal conductivities of LN and LT crystals were measured. They strongly depended on the nonstoichiometric defect density. Near-stoichiometric LT exhibited the largest thermal conductivity, which is promising a great advantage in QPM frequency conversion.

articleTitle: Mid-IR generation by difference frequency mixing of two pulsed PPLN OPOs in ZnGeP/sub 2/
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two pulsed grazing-incidence PPLN OPO's are used to generate mid-IR radiation by difference mixing in zinc germanium phosphide. 22% photon conversion was achieved with 87 mW average input power.

articleTitle: Quantum gate characterization in an extended Hilbert space
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe an approach for characterizing optical quantum gates, by constructing models which incorporate mode-matching effects. Quantum process tomography is then performed on the model. The techniques can be generalized to other quantum computing architectures.

articleTitle: Strong photo-absorption by a single quantum wire in waveguide-transmission measurement
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured absorption spectrum of a single T-shaped quantum wire at 5K by waveguide-transmission spectroscopy. The absolute value of absorption at one-dimensional-ground-state exciton peak is 84 cm/sup -1/ despite a single wire.

articleTitle: Magnetization imaging of single CdMnTe/ZnTe quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Exciton magnetic polarons in CdMnTe QDs form through the spontaneous ferromagnetic alignment of the Mn. We show evidence that after EMP recombination, the Mn magnetization persists, directly impacting the next occupation.

articleTitle: Laser WakeField Acceleration of 170 MeV Quasi-Monoenergetic Electron Beams
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of high quality electron beams resulting from the interaction of ultrashort and ultraintense laser pulses with underdense plasmas. The electron energy distribution is quasi-monoenergetic and peaks at 170 MeV

articleTitle: Light depolarization by Mie scatterers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Light depolarization by Mie scatterers of arbitrary size and refractive index is studied analytically. The isotropization length l/sub p/ responsible for light linear depolarization is presented. Linear and circular depolarization by Mie scatterers is addressed quantitatively.

articleTitle: TN-LC cells as an Elliptical Phase Retarder by heterodyne interferometric ellipsometry
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A polarized heterodyne ellipsometer to characterize TN-LC by elliptical parameters of polarization state is proposed. The twist angle and untwisted phase retardation can be measured precisely that TN-LC is verified as an elliptical retarder properly

articleTitle: Optical sensor based on resonant porous silicon structures
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new geometry for an optical sensor that is based on porous silicon structures. The sensitivity of the sensor is enhanced compared to the conventional surface plasmon resonance based sensors.

articleTitle: Third order intermodulation on nonlinear dispersive radio-on-fiber links
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A study of intermodulation distortion was conducted to evaluate system performance of high-power DSB and SSB modulated radio-on-fiber links. Investigation showed that power penalty still exists in SSB system due to nonlinearity and chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Coherent optical manipulation of quantum dot spins: a path into quantum computing
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent control of quantum dot qubits transfers optical coherence to electronic coherence and provides a means to demonstrate details of quantum computing including creation/detection of entangled states and qubit rotations. The measurements also provide insight into physical phenomena such as spontaneously generated spin coherence.

articleTitle: Novel Approach to Efficient UV Emitters by Frequency-Doubling in Nitrides-Based Structures from Laser Diode
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose to achieve efficient UV emission by frequency-doubling laser diodes in nitrides-based structures. Output powers of more than 5 mW at 340 nm can be generated, with the possibility of extending deep into UV

articleTitle: Low frequency conductivity scaling in CaRuO/sub 3/
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have studied the conductivity of CaRuO/sub 3/ films using time domain terahertz spectroscopy. Deviations from Fermi liquid theory and observation of a scaling law suggest the proximity of the material to a quantum critical point.

articleTitle: Phase-locked and Q-switched two-element fiber-laser array
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Phase-locked and Q-switched outputs of a two-element fiber laser array in a common resonator are achieved. The phase locking is highly stable despite constant and random changes in path lengths in the individual elements.

articleTitle: Telecom wavelength quantum dot single photon source
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the first on-demand single photon source that is compatible with standard telecom optical fibre. The source may be useful for fibre optic-based single-photon applications, including quantum metrology, quantum communications and distributed quantum computing.

articleTitle: Modeling and fabrication of sub-diffraction nanophotonic waveguides constructed via DNA-directed self-assembled quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the design, model, and preliminary fabrication results for a sub-diffraction nanophotonic waveguide composed of quantum dots organized on a substrate via a DNA-programmable self-assembly process and optically pumped with CW light.

articleTitle: Reaching nonlinear regime in Raman amplification of ultrashort laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper, we present, for the first time, clear evidence of reaching the nonlinear regime of Raman Backscattering (RBS) amplification with pulse intensity amplification exciting 1000 in 2 mm long plasma and exciting pump intensity by more than order of magnitude. We have demonstrated energy amplification of up to /spl sim/5000 for a seed with a low input energy (<0.2 pJ) and up to /spl sim/60 for a seed with high input energy (7.5 pJ). The output energy grew exponentially when the input was low and the gain indicated "saturation" when the input was high.

articleTitle: Formation, Detection and Trapping of Photoassociated Ultracold KRb Molecules
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultracold ground-state KRb molecules are formed by photoassociation and detected by resonant two-photon ionization. We have assigned both the photoassociation spectrum and the detection laser spectrum, and we have demonstrated magnetic trapping of triplet KRb

articleTitle: Heavy-ion dynamics in the acceleration of protons by the interaction of high-power lasers with double-layer targets
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The dynamics of heavy-ions during the laser acceleration of protons is theoretically studied by means of 2D particle-in-cell simulations and a 1D analytical hydrodynamic model. The heavy-ion motion is found to modify the longitudinal electric field distribution, thus changing the acceleration conditions for the protons.

articleTitle: Diffracted evanescent wave model for enhancement and suppression of optical transmission of subwavelength hole arrays
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new model of enhanced transmission of hole arrays accounts for both transmission suppression and modest enhancement, without a surface plasmon resonance; the model is valid for nonmetallic systems, and is supported by recent experiments.

articleTitle: Diode Pumped Cesium Laser
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a continuous-wave diode laser pumped cesium vapor laser. We achieved a forty percent slope efficiency relative to the pump power in a non-optimized experiment

articleTitle: Recent progress towards a petawatt power using optical parametric chirped pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental results on the optical parametric chirped pulse amplification and compression of femtosecond pulses. Chirped pulses with spectral width 70 nm were amplified in a three-stage optical parametric amplifier system up to 35 J. The measured amplified pulsewidth after compression was 85 fs indicating a potential peak power of over 0.35 PW.

articleTitle: Dielectric waveguide optimisation for GaAs based quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Significant improvements in the threshold current density and in the slope efficiency of GaAs quantum cascade lasers are obtained by using dielectric waveguides based on Al/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As and Ga/sub 0.49/In/sub 0.51/P cladding layers.

articleTitle: Two-photon "ghost" imaging with thermal light
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of thermal "ghost" imaging. Similarly to the case of entangled states, a two-photon Gaussian thin lens equation is observed. Differences and similarities to entangled "ghost" imaging are discussed.

articleTitle: Electroluminescence cooling in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Semiconductor electroluminescence cooling is studied and its theoretical limits for net cooling efficiency and cooling power density are evaluated. The results shows that cooling can be possibly realized using electroluminescence upconversion in LEDs.

articleTitle: Advanced dielectric grating technology for high-energy petawatt lasers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the design, fabrication, and test of large-area multilayer dielectric gratings for high-energy petawatt lasers. 80/spl times/40-cm/sup 2/, 1780-mm/sup -1/ gratings have been fabricated, exhibiting high diffraction efficiency and >4 J/cm/sup 2/, 10-ps damage thresholds on witness samples.

articleTitle: Ultra High Intensity Laser Launched Radiative Shock Waves Related to Supernova Remnant Formation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show evidence for strongly radiative laser produced shocks in cluster media. In addition blast front thinning suggests the onset of accessing a regime possibly susceptible for hydrodynamic instabilities related to supernova remnant formation

articleTitle: Novel 560 nm yellow-green laser using stabilized broad-area laser diode and PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a practical 560 nm yellow-green laser using a novel external resonator for a high-power broad-area laser diode and a periodically poled LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide. Conversion efficiency of 320%/W and output stability within /spl plusmn/2% was achieved.

articleTitle: Adiabatic energy concentration in graded nanoplasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We predict that surface plasmon polaritons propagating toward the tip of a tapered plasmonic waveguide are slowed down and asymptotically stopped when they tend to the tip, never actually reaching it (the travel time to the tip is logarithmically divergent). This phenomenon causes accumulation of energy and giant local fields at the tip. There are various prospective applications in nanooptics and nanotechnology.

articleTitle: High-order split-step finite difference method for nonlinear optical pulse propagation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using high-order finite differences, a new split-step method with optimum complexity for the nonlinear Schrodinger equation is presented. For accurate simulations of large WDM systems, substantial speed-up factors over the split-step Fourier method are obtained.

articleTitle: Ultrafast electronic dynamics in unipolar n-doped InAs/GaAs quantum dot structures
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time-resolved mid-infrared-pump, optical-probe differential transmission spectroscopy on n-doped quantum dots directly reveals electron dynamics relevant to unipolar devices. Capture times into excited and ground states are found to be 7.1 and 116 ps.

articleTitle: Tunneling assisted two-photon absorption: The Nonlinear Franz-Keldysh Effect
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The N-photon absorption coefficient of a direct-semiconductor is calculated under the influence of a DC-field. For N>2 the system presents the same structure as the Linear Franz-Keldysh effect, oscillations for homega>E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub>/2, and tunneling for homega<E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub>/2

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical Boolean XOR logic using semiconductor optical amplifier-assisted Sagnac switch
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical Boolean XOR logic is demonstrated using a semiconductor optical amplifier-assisted Sagnac switch for full duty cycle and bit pattern switching at 20 GHz and 20 Gb/s, with low signal energies and negligible pattern effect.

articleTitle: Enhanced backscattering of vortex fields
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The effect of using an illumination beam with a phase screw dislocation (a so called optical vortex beam) on filtering the path lengths contributions to enhanced backscattering from random media was studied theoretically and demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy of matrix-isolated perylene-related molecules
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on experimental and theoretical investigations of matrix-isolated molecules of MePTCDI, presenting transient absorption spectra obtained with ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy. The experimental transient absorption spectrum is consistently explained by highly-correlated quantum-chemical calculation methods.

articleTitle: Generation of Multiple Idlers at Different Polarizations in Dual-Pump Fiber Optical Parametric Amplifiers: Experiments and Applications
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multiple, polarization-diverse, idlers are generated in a dual-pump fiber parametric amplifier. A polarization beam splitter is employed to separate orthogonally-polarized idlers. The configuration can be used in telecommunications to copy and re-direct data signals

articleTitle: Coherence preparation using simultaneous femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We simulate the preparation of laser-induced vibrational coherence in the femtosecond time scale. By optimizing that coherence one can maximize the molecular CARS signal.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser ablation of silicon (100) with thermal oxide thin films of varying thickness
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond laser ablation of silicon (100) with thermal oxide thin films was studied in order to further understand the ablative properties of thin films and to evaluate their influence on the ablation of the substrate.

articleTitle: Instantaneous measurement of NH/sub 3/ and NO/sub x/ by using near- and mid-infrared coherent light sources
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Instantaneous measurement of NH/sub 3/ and NO/sub x/ both in near-infrared (near-IR) and mid-infrared (mid-IR) region provided by single difference frequency generation device is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low-temperature, photoluminescence-excitation spectroscopy of individual carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Our studies of photoluminescence excitation spectra of individual carbon nanotubes indicate strong electron-phonon coupling leading to a high intensity of phonon-assisted optical transitions and a large broadening of excited states induced by inelastic electron-phonon scattering.

articleTitle: Lateral diffusion of excitons in double quantum well structures
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on lateral diffusion measurements of excitons in GaAs/AlGaAs double quantum wells of various width. In wide quantum wells the excitons have lifetime up to 10 microseconds and diffusion length up to 500 microns.

articleTitle: Spectral efficiency and nonlinear tolerance of DPSK formats in 160 Gb/s Raman amplified systems
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 5-channel 160 Gb/s WDM systems using ABA dispersion map and Raman amplification are investigated. RZ-DPSK can offer 2300 km distance. CSRZ-DPSK offers 1900 km and 2 ps/nm dispersion tolerance and spectral efficiency of 0.72 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Four-wave mixing in small ensembles: from free-polarization decay to photon echoes
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe the transient third-order polarization emitted from individual excitonic transitions and monitor the evolution, from a free-polarization decay to a photon echo with increasing number of transitions in the inhomogeneous ensemble.

articleTitle: Classical spin-orbit coupling of light in micro-dome cavities with Bragg mirrors
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study vectorial modes in dome-shaped high-finesse microcavities in which one of the mirrors is a planar DBR. Its birefringence leads to an externally controllable, classical spin-orbit coupling of light.

articleTitle: Near-field imaging of short pulse dynamics in nonlinear planar silica waveguides
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Imaging by a simplified near-field scanning optical microscope and numerical simulations reveal the complex spatiotemporal dynamics during the propagation of 60-fs pulses in nonlinear planar silica waveguides, in the anomalous dispersion regime.

articleTitle: Atom-field quantum state manipulation and storage
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present various schemes to manipulate and store quantum optical fields into atomic ensembles and show how to realize quantum memory operations, entangle atomic ensembles or teleport an atomic ensemble quantum state with high efficiency.

articleTitle: Laser Guiding at Relativistic Intensities and Wake-field Particle Acceleration in Plasma Channels
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High quality electron beams with hundreds of picoCoulombs of charge in percent energy spread above 80 MeV were produced for the first time in high gradient laser wakefield accelerators by guiding the drive laser pulse

articleTitle: Molecular probe of the BCS/BEC crossover in /sup 6/Li
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have produced a molecular Bose-Einstein condensate from fermionic /sup 6/Li atoms. Optical molecular spectroscopy is used to probe the many-body state in the BCS/BEC crossover region. Preliminary results indicate that the molecular contribution is much larger than expected.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of a Staged Optical Injection and Laser Wakefield Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A proof-of-principal experiment on staged optical injection and laser acceleration was performed. Electrons created in one gas jet were injected and accelerated to 20 MeV in the plasma wakefield of the second gas jet

articleTitle: Temporal contrast enhanced to 10/sup -10/ for Petawatt scale femtosecond lasers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new non-linear solid-state technique for temporal femtosecond pulses cleaning. The contrast reaches 10/sup -10/ for millijoule input pulse. The method is reliable enough to solve the contrast issue for petawatt class lasers.

articleTitle: Amplified spontaneous emission and two-photon fluorescence in an organic single crystal composed of excited-state intramolecular proton transfer molecules
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Low-threshold amplified spontaneous emission of blue fluorescence was observed in an organic single crystal composed of excited-state intramolecular proton transfer molecules. The two-photon absorption spectrum has also been measured for efficient upconverted blue emission.

articleTitle: Spin-memory and anomalous polarization properties of single InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Control of electronic spins in individual InGaAs quantum dots is achieved by applying vertical electric and magnetic fields. In addition, dots with anomalously large degree of linear polarization are found weakly affected by magnetic field.

articleTitle: Generation of Mid-IR laser by PPMgLN OPO/DFG configuration
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We generated mid-IR laser in absorptive wavelength region around 6.1 /spl mu/m by combining QPM OPO and extra-cavity QPM DFG. The emission wavelength in OPO deviated from the prediction by reported Sellmeier equation in Mg:LN.

articleTitle: Excitonic Autler-Townes splitting induced by an intense terahertz field
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An InGaAs quantum well driven by a strong THz field has exhibited a splitting of the exciton line, due to strong coupling of hole states. This effect is closely-related to the Autler-Townes effect and electromagnetically-induced-transparency.

articleTitle: Mask design for the space interferometry mission internal metrology
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Heterodyne laser interferometers are used to measure the changes in optical path length of the arms of stellar interferometers. Numerical diffraction analysis is used to design masks, constrained by diffraction, crosstalk, and power loss requirements.

articleTitle: 532 nm pumped optical parametric oscillator using periodically-poled stoichiometric LiTaO/sub 3/
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A pulsed tunable optical parametric oscillator using periodically-poled stoichiometric lithium tantalate pumped at 532 nm is reported. The tuning range achieved was from 0.65 /spl mu/m to 2.97 /spl mu/m and the photon conversion efficiency was 40%.

articleTitle: A Radio-on-DWDM Transport System Employing Double External Light Injection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A radio-on-dense-wavelength-division-multiplexing (DWDM) transport system employing double external light injection techniques to improve systems' performance is proposed and demonstrated. Such a proposed radio-on-DWDM transport system is suitable for the application of microwave optical links.

articleTitle: Generalized method for non-linearity compensation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A unified method for nonlinearity compensation is demonstrated using a new graphical approach. This method provides deep physical insight of the known nonlinearity compensation techniques and allows deriving new compensation schemes.

articleTitle: Raman optical lattice
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel optical lattice of reduced periodicity that is based on Raman transitions. We demonstrate and characterize laser cooling in this lattice. Our observations are in agreement with theoretical results.

articleTitle: Near-field measurements of the speckle pattern for diffusive and localized waves in random media
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present measurements of the speckle pattern for two perpendicular polarization components of the field transmitted through random quasi -one dimensional samples as a function of incident frequency for both diffusive and localized microwave radiation.

articleTitle: Non-Markovian dynamics in a dense potassium vapor
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using transient four-wave mixing, we have observed the relaxation dynamics of a dense potassium vapor whose dephasing time is large compared to the collision duration, revealing a clear transition from non-Markovian to Markovian dynamics.

articleTitle: 1.3W Ripple-Free Superluminescent LED
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The experimental characterisation of high-power, ripple-free superluminescent diodes is presented. Record-breaking output optical powers from anti-reflection coated tapered contact devices have been achieved. Spectral modulation is suppressed by utilising a V-groove etched deflector

articleTitle: Storage and release of femtosecond laser pulses in a resonant photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrashort laser pulses can be decelerated or stopped by launching the femtosecond pulses into a resonant photonic crystal and release by re-acceleration can be realized through inter-pulse collision.

articleTitle: Development of a pulsed quantum cascade laser based CO sensor using advanced signal processing techniques
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A pulsed, thermoelectrically cooled 4.6 /spl mu/m DFB-QCL CO sensor, incorporating a 100 m multipass cell and HgCdTe detector, is used to evaluate various processing schemes and their effects on temporal resolution, sensitivity, and selectivity of the spectrometer.

articleTitle: Probing the microscopic origin of many-body interactions in semiconductors using optical two-dimensional Fourier transform spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Microscopic origins are elucidated for the many-body interactions between the light hole exciton, heavy hole exciton and continuum electronic resonances in GaAs quantum wells using optical two-dimensional Fourier transform spectroscopy.

articleTitle: All-optical OC-192 NRZ-to-PRZ data-format conversion by injection-locking a synchronously modulated Fabry-Perot laser diode
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An OC-192 all-optical non-return-to-zero-to-pseudo-return-to-zero data-format converter with 1.5 dB power penalty at bit-error-rate of <10/sup -9/ is demonstrated by employing an optical-injection-induced threshold reduction technique to gain-switch a Fabry-Perot laser diode synchronously modulated at below threshold condition.

articleTitle: Ultraslow light propagation in an erbium-ions-doped crystal
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Slow light propagation results from the large dispersion of the refraction index. We report on such effect obtained by coherent population oscillations in an erbium doped crystal, corresponding to a group velocity of 3 m/s.

articleTitle: Photonic Zener tunneling
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate photonic Zener-tunneling in waveguide arrays biased by a transverse index gradient. We observe Bloch oscillations and Zener breakdown by monitoring the fluorescence emitted by the guided light during its propagation.

articleTitle: Relativistic synchrotron radiation pulse
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Synchrotron radiation by a single rotating electron and by an electron cloud in a lasetron is considered in the Heaviside-Feynman approach, which yields simple analytical solutions for the temporal shape of radiation pulses.

articleTitle: Tuning the nanooptics of metallic nanorods: size, geometry and end effects
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The nanooptics of plasmons in metallic nanorods is investigated theoretically. The effects of nanorod size, shape and interrod coupling are studied. Rods with concave ends exhibit narrow, cavity-like resonances unlike typical plasmon resonances.

articleTitle: A New Method of Anisotropic Conductive Film Bonding by High Power Diode Laser(HPDL)
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: New bonding processes between TCP and glass panel with ACF using HPDL are investigated. Results showed that this method can solve conventional bonding problems caused by pressure unbalance and thermal expansion mismatch of hot plate.

articleTitle: Light propagation in a nonlinear plasmonic nanowire
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear transmission of optical nanowires consisting of metallic spheres embedded in dielectric nanoshells made of Kerr material is demonstrated. Nonlinear optical phenomena, such as power dependence of mode frequency, switching, or optical limiting are discussed.

articleTitle: H - waves in nonlinear AlGaAs waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically demonstrate that optical discrete H-waves are possible in normally dispersive waveguide arrays. Methods to excite this family of waves in AlGaAs systems are presented.

articleTitle: Resonant coupling of localized modes in one-dimensional random media
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatial field profiles are measured in a single mode random 1D waveguide. For particular random configurations, we observe resonant coupling via spectrally adjacent modes localized at different positions along the sample length.

articleTitle: Ultrafast quantum kinetics of semiconductor intersubband transitions: polaron signatures and dephasing dynamics
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The ultrafast intersubband dynamics in a semiconductor quantum well subband system is investigated theoretically. Non-Markovian electron-phonon interaction leads to polaron formation and enhanced dephasing.

articleTitle: Millijoule pulses from a double-passed, quasi-phase-matched optical-parametric chirped-pulse amplifier
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel scheme is described that overcomes parametric-fluorescence limitations of quasi-phase-matched, optical-parametric chirped-pulse amplification to produce millijoule pulse energies at 1053 nm. High gain, beam quality, bandwidth, and extreme prepulse contrast are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Bragg spectroscopy of a Bose condensate in a 3D optical lattice
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured the excitation spectrum of an /sup 87/Rb Bose-Einstein condensate loaded in a three dimensional optical lattice using Bragg spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Plasmonic Nanophotonics: Coupling Light to Nanoscale via Plasmons
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An incompatibility between light wavelength at the microscale and devices at the nanoscale can be addressed with plasmonic nanostructures. Plasmonic nanophotonics promises to create new prospects for sensing molecules and guiding light on the nanoscale

articleTitle: Practical double plasma-mirror pulse cleaner for high-intensity femtosecond laser-plasma harmonics
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A practical double plasma-mirror built into a f=10 m null telescope has been added as a standard feature of a 50 fs 3J laser system for ultraintense laser-matter interaction. Contrast >10/sup 10/ is obtained, maintaining excellent focusability.

articleTitle: Optical waveguiding in suspensions of dielectric particles
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Waveguiding is observed in a liquid core/liquid cladding waveguide containing a suspension of dielectric particles in the core. The threshold for guiding is determined by the numerical aperture of the effective refractive index.

articleTitle: Generation of THz surface plasmon-polaritons by a superluminous optical spot
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose to use an optical beam scanning a semiconductor surface and creating a spot of nonlinear polarization to launch terahertz surface waves. This offers new ways to build THz sources and perform surface spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Comparison of a non-resonant and a signal-resonant four mirror optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High energy performance of a two crystal four mirror non-resonant and signal-resonant optical parametric ring oscillator was demonstrated. The signal-resonant oscillator had idler dumping between the crystals. Differences occurred in beam profile and stability.

articleTitle: All optical quantum dot spin manipulation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The coherence time of an excess electron spin confined in a quantum dot structure is expected to be orders of magnitude longer than the typical timescales required for its coherent manipulation. Motivated by this observation, several groups have proposed to use single quantum dot spins as quantum bits (qubits), and to manipulate, couple and measure individual spins using either transport or optical techniques. In the case of quantum dots with stronger confinement along the growth direction, lowest energy elementary optical transitions are those arising from excitation of a m/sub z/=3/2 (m/sub z/=-3/2) valence band electron to a m/sub z/=1/2 (m/sub z/=-1/2) conduction band state. If the quantum dot already has an excess conduction band electron, only one of these optical (trion) transitions is allowed; the other is spin (Pauli) blocked, in contrast, a neutral quantum dot always has a pair of exciton excitations. It has been suggested that Pauli blocking of absorption or fluorescence can be used to implement high efficiency all-optical single-spin measurements and conditional spin dynamics. In this talk, we will review our work aimed at experimental demonstration of Pauli blocking and single-spin measurement in single-electron-charged self-assembled quantum dots.

articleTitle: Spin-coherence-induced hole burning in charged GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spin-coherence-induced hole burning is clearly identified in high-resolution nearly degenerate differential transmission experiment. The inhomogeneously broadened spin decoher-ence time is extracted from the narrow hole-burning widths, and approaches 11 nsec at zero field.

articleTitle: Unusual properties and control of the initial decoherence in quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pure dephasing is a genuine quantum kinetic process resulting in a nonexponential decay of optical signals with an unusual nonmonotonous temperature dependence of the decay time. The coherent controllability of the initial decoherence is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Photoassociation Spectroscopy of Cold Alkaline Earth Atoms near the Intercombination Line
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The properties of photoassociation spectra near the intercombination line of group II atoms are theoretically investigated. Unlike in most current photoassociation spectroscopy the Doppler effect can significantly affect the shape of the investigated lines

articleTitle: Stability Properties of a Nonlinear Coherent Atomic-Molecular Poulation Trapping State
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We take the Bogoliubov approach and study various low-temperature instabilities of a coherent population trapping state in an atom-molecule system involving an effective optical field and a Feshbach resonance

articleTitle: Tapered micro-structured optical fiber pigtails for waveguide coupling
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate pigtailed, tapered microstructured optical fiber couplers for use with high-index, small mode-field diameter waveguides. We achieve adiabatic reduction in mode field dimensions to less than 2 /spl mu/m with low excess loss.

articleTitle: Electro-optic waveguide modulators fabricated using thin films of lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electro-optic ridge waveguide modulators based on sub-micron thin films of lithium niobate prepared by crystal ion slicing and wafer bonding are demonstrated. The modulators have low insertion loss and have V/sub /spl pi//L as low as 13 V-cm at /spl lambda/=1.55 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Acceleration of electrons from rest to GeV energies by intense transverse magnetic laser pulses in free space
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that electrons can be accelerated from rest by the longitudinal electric field of an intense TM/sub 01/ optical pulse. Numerical simulations predict net energy gains in the GeV range for laser intensities reaching 10/sup 22/ W/cm/sup 2/.

articleTitle: Observation of quantum interference in an organic solid
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe spatial interference between frequencies /spl omega/ and 3/spl omega/ in fluorescence of organic chromophore in a polymer film. Interference occurs between one- and three-photon transition pathways when the chromophore has a large three-photon absorption cross section.

articleTitle: Photons with an orbital angular momentum generated in an optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the fabrication of an all-fiber component which confers an orbital angular momentum to guided light. The device is based on a helical long-period-grating in a two-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Vacuum scattering technique for wakefield electron beam diagnostic and conditioning measurements
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the theoretical prediction and experimental verification of polarization independence of direct laser scattering of free electrons in vacuum. Simulations show multi-MeV electron scattering is possible. The focal volume requirement for independence is derived.

articleTitle: Direct observation of optical precursors in a region of anomalous dispersion
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe the creation of optical precursors when a step-modulated optical pulse propagates through a linear resonant absorber. The precursors are the dominant part of the transmitted field, displaying 100% transmission at their maximum amplitude.

articleTitle: Plasmon-induced magnetization of periodic nanohole arrays
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Plasmon-induced magnetism of periodic nanohole arrays has been studied using transmission spectroscopy and magnetic-force microscopy. This second-order nonlinear optical effect can find numerous applications in magneto-optical data storage and optical communication and computing.

articleTitle: Diffraction from Arbitrarily Deformed Volume Holograms
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimentally and analyze the volume hologram response to deformation due to a point indenter. The results show the emergence of multiple peaks in the diffraction pattern, explained as the dominant frequency components of the deformed gratings

articleTitle: Coherent control of stimulated emission process inside one-dimensional photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The control of the stimulated emission processes in a 1D PC is discussed. A non-canonical quantization is adopted (QNM). The decay rate of the stimulated emission depends on the cavity and phase-difference of the pumps.

articleTitle: Localized surface-avoiding modes: a new approach to resonant cavities
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe a new kind of confined acoustic mode in a superlattice slab. This mode avoids the surfaces and exhibits a maximum at the center of the superlattice which behaves as a resonant cavity.

articleTitle: Disruption of Bose-Einstein condensates on classical and quantum reflection
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that quantum-mechanical reflection can severely disrupt the structure of Bose-Einstein condensates and explain anomalously low reflection coefficients recently observed for condensates reflected from a Si surface.

articleTitle: Near-field intensity correlations in semicontinuous metal films
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatial intensity correlation functions of semicontinuous metal-dielectric films of varying metal concentration, p, were obtained from near-field microscopy. The data shows a transition from propagation to localization and back to propagation of optical excitations with increase in p

articleTitle: Design of the Texas petawatt laser
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the design of a novel, high energy (200 J), short pulse (150 fs) laser that is based on hybrid, broadband optical parametric chirped pulse amplification (OPCPA) and mixed silicate and phosphate Nd:glass amplification.

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics in self-assembled ErAs nanoislands measured by optical-pump THz-probe spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use optical-pump THz-probe spectroscopy to study carrier dynamics in self-assembled ErAs:GaAs nanoislands. Sub-picosecond carrier capture times are measured, indicating the potential of these devices as THz detectors comparable to low temperature grown GaAs.

articleTitle: Broadband and gap-free response of a terahertz system using poled polymers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Poled polymer films are employed for terahertz (THz) generation and detection, with an observable gap-free bandwidth of /spl sim/12 THz. The bandwidth dependence on the group velocity mismatch in the polymer films is experimentally studied.

articleTitle: Continuous wave generated nanosecond electrical and optical pulses from photorefractive lithium niobate fibers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed nanosecond electrical and optical pulsations from photorefractive lithium-niobate optical fibers using low-power lasers (/spl sim/=532 nm). Fourier spectra of the pulsations have a maximum at /spl sim/900 MHz with peaks separated by /spl sim/30 MHz.

articleTitle: Simultaneous analytical characterisation of two unknown ultrashort laser pulses: blind-MEFISTO
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new analytical methodology that allows simultaneously characterizing two unknown ultrashort pulses with the same central frequency. This analysis is based on Fourier transform spectrally resolved interferometric collinear correlations in the delay domain.

articleTitle: Cavity QED with quantized center of mass: correlation functions, tunneling, and entanglement
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We examine nonclassical correlations and entanglement for an atom in a driven cavity (Cavity QED) with an external potential. The external potential introduces new degrees of freedom that require treatment of the center of mass motion including tunneling. We find a very sensitive dependence of quantum correlation functions on center of mass motion.

articleTitle: Vectorial pulsed Bessel beams in periodic layered media
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Existence of dispersion-free and diffraction-free ultra-short vectorial pulsed Bessel beams is predicted in one-dimensional photonic bandgaps (PBGs) using a Wannier-function technique. Pulsed Bessel beam propagation in a GaAs layered PBG is in particular considered.

articleTitle: Ultra-narrow asymmetric filter for transmission with 0.8 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel approach is proposed to ultra-narrow optical filtering in dense WDM transmission. The filter based on fiber Bragg grating is specially designed and fabricated to be slightly asymmetric. A feasibility of 8/spl times/40Gbit/s DWDM RZ transmission with 0.8 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency (without PDM and FEC) over 1280 km of SMF/DCF link has been confirmed by numerical modelling.

articleTitle: Optical processor using waveguide holograms in multimode interference (MMI) couplers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A spatial optical pattern processor using 2-dimensional holograms in multimode interference (MMI) couplers is proposed and analyzed. A theory is developed to describe MMI holograms which show good agreement with beam propagation simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Modulation transfer using coherent Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a scheme based on coherent Raman scattering for efficient transfer of amplitude and phase modulation from one frequency to another. Experimental results show bandwidths of at least tens of MHz and 99% fidelity.

articleTitle: Microscopic theory of photoluminescence from semiconductor quantum dots in microcavities
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The dynamics of spontaneous and stimulated emission from semiconductor quantum dots in pillar microcavities is studied within a theory-experiment comparison. The non-exponential decay of the time-resolved photoluminescence is addressed.

articleTitle: Controlled spatial and spectral coupling of single InAs excitons to photonic crystal nanocavity modes
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a method to deterministically couple single InAs quantum dots to photonic crystal nanocavities based on high resolution active positioning and the ability to tune the mode through the ensemble quantum dot spectrum.

articleTitle: Two-photon interference in an EIT system
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
