abstract: The possibility of storing and retrieving a single photon of SPDC entangled photon pairs is examined by using electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT). The theory of a proof of principle two-photon interferometer demonstrates new features.

articleTitle: Focusing ground state xenon using large quasi-electrostatic potentials
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We focus ground state xenon atoms using a high intensity (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) optical field and map the atomic density at the focus using multiphoton ionization. The results are in agreement with a quasi-electrostatic model

articleTitle: Dephasing of the LH-HH exciton Raman coherence in GaAs quantum wells: distinguishing between phonon and carrier scattering
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Three-beam four-wave mixing shows anti-correlated scattering of HH and LH excitons in GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells, suggesting that exciton-phonon scattering dominates the exciton dephasing. The correlation increases at higher excitation densities.

articleTitle: Generating multiple components of Bose-Condensate by controllable QUIC trap
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper, we report our newly observed phenomenon in magnetically trapped <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb condensate to form the multiple components of condensate in the F=2 hyperfine state. Different from confining the condensate in optical trap or RF transition between hyperfine components in magnetic trap, only a magnetic trap is used in our investigation. In our case, the multiple components of condensate are formed during the process of switching off the magnetic field, in which no RF source is used to transition of one hyperfine component to other one. A numerical analysis is given to explain the phenomenon observed in our experiment

articleTitle: Kinetic theory of the electron transport in the two photon photo emission at semiconductor surfaces
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A theoretical description of ultrafast phonon induced electronic transport between surface and bulk states after optical excitation is presented. In particular, the influence of the electron transfer processes on two photon photo emission is evaluated.

articleTitle: Long-period fiber grating inscription by high-intensity femtosecond UV laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using high-intensity (100-500 GW/cm/sup 2/) 264 nm laser radiation, we fabricated long-period fiber gratings in telecom and photosensitive fibers, studied their temperature sensing properties and demonstrated the effect of thermal recovery of a LPFG resonance peak.

articleTitle: Saturation of the ultrafast laser-induced demagnetization in nickel
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show saturation of the sub-picosecond demagnetization in nickel at high excitation densities, conclude that spin relaxation is incomplete, and associate the demagnetization with collapse of the Stoner gap due to band filling effects.

articleTitle: High DC voltage discharges induced using femtosecond terawatt laser-generated plasma filaments
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The characteristics of DC-voltage discharges, triggered using plasma filaments, along their propagation path were investigated and sonographic probing was carried out. The triggering and guiding of high DC-voltage discharges in a 1-m-long gap were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Observations cross-absorption modulation mediated by coherent population trapping in hot rubidium vapor
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using the four-level N-system discussed by Schmidt and Imamoglu, Opt. Lett. 21,1936(1996), we observe cross-absorption modulation in hot rubidium atoms. Quantum coherences from coherent population trapping create larger Kerr nonlinearities than conventional three-level cascade systems.

articleTitle: Ultrafast magnetization control in III-Mn-V ferromagnetic semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that a circularly polarized optical pulse can rotate the collective magnetization of a III-Mn-V ferromagnetic semiconductor during femtosecond time scales. Our theory highlights the important role of the hole-spin relaxation.

articleTitle: Measurement of small surface displacements by femtosecond laser methods
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Theoretical and experimental investigations of the measurement of small harmonic surface oscillations with the help of a femtosecond laser are presented. It is shown that the large number of laser radiation modes allows a considerable increase in the signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Observation of a 1D and 2D dark notch formed in a quadratic photorefractive medium
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the observation of a 1D and 2D dark notch in an unpoled SBN:75 crystal using the quadratic electro-optic effect. Both the 1D and 2D dark notches are observed to be fixed in the crystal.

articleTitle: Terahertz near-field microscopy
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present results on the spatial extent and origin of the near-field of a metal tip and the first measurement on a crystal of CsI using THz apertureless scanning near-field optical microscopy.

articleTitle: Experiments with Counter-propagating Laser Pulses at Relativistic Intensities
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the precise spatial and temporal overlap of two counter-propagating, focused laser pulses at intensities above the relativistic threshold. In a first experiment a single-shot autocorrelation was carried out. Further applications are discussed

articleTitle: Ultrafast carrier dynamics in amorphous semiconductors determined by time-resolved THz and NIR spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We determine ultrafast carrier dynamics characteristic of disordered semiconductors, including both dispersive transport and bimolecular recombination, via self-consistent modeling of time-resolved measurements in both the far-infrared (THz) and near-infrared spectral regions.

articleTitle: Dynamic Acceleration Effects in Explosions of Laser Irradiated Heteronuclear Clusters
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Based on the model for heteronuclear cluster explosions developed by Last and Jortner, we present experimental confirmation of the theoretically predicted ion energy enhancement of the light ion species in methane clusters

articleTitle: Effect of CO/sub 2/ laser irradiation on refractive index modulation in photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Refractive index modulation in endlessly-single-mode photonic crystal fiber by CO/sub 2/ laser irradiation without surface-deformation is experimentally confirmed with a value of 1.68/spl times/10/sup -3/ for the first time, which is contributed by mechanical stress relaxation in fiber.

articleTitle: Tunable, all-solid-state, continuous-wave source for the blue using BiB/sub 3/O/sub 6/
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the generation of tunable continuous-wave (cw) radiation in the blue by intracavity frequency-doubling of an all-solid-state Ti:sapphire laser in the crystal of BiB/sub 3/O/sub 6/. Wavelength tuning over the range of 373-435 nm is demonstrated and cw blue powers of 350 mW have been obtained without optimisation.

articleTitle: Analysis of time-correlated single photon detection in a multi-wavelength quantum key distribution network
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We evaluate time-correlated single photon detection as a key rate enhancement technique in a wavelength-addressed, auto-compensating quantum key distribution network by calculating the network's aggregate effective key rate.

articleTitle: Wavelet-transform analysis of spectral interferometry for phase reconstruction of femtosecond optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a new technique: wavelet-transform analysis for phase reconstruction through spectral phase interferometry. The technique directly extracts phase from spectral interference fringes without using temporal filter, thus essentially eliminates uncertainties in retrieved phase.

articleTitle: Alternate spin profile reconstruction in low-PMD fibers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Any kind of spin profile transferred into fibers during the drawing process is accurately determined by exploiting a cut-back method together with a deterministic waveplate model. Reconstructed constant and sinusoidal spin profiles are shown.

articleTitle: Interference effects in transient Kerr spectra of a semiconductor multilayer structure
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The spectral dependences of transient Faraday and Kerr effects near exciton resonances in a GaAs multiple quantum well do not obey a Kramers-Kronig relationship. This is due to multiple reflection effects on the Kerr spectra.

articleTitle: Steering of optical beams using true-time delay based on the white cell
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a true-time delay approach for steering optical beams over wide angles (approaching /spl plusmn/57/spl deg/), without dispersion or sidelobes. A white cell with reflecting piston actuators provides delays from 1/500 to 3001.

articleTitle: Novel regrowth-free vertical active-passive integration scheme with improved fabrication tolerance
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel vertically-coupled active-passive integration architecture that provides an order of magnitude reduction in coupling coefficient variation between misaligned waveguides when compared with a conventional vertically-coupled structure.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced magnetochiral anisotropy in resonant medium
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electromagnetically induced coherence can significantly increase optical response of atomic or molecular system. We demonstrate very large magneto-chiral anisotropy by applying resonant optical fields to atomic rubidium vapor.

articleTitle: How effective is the effective refractive index?
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photonic crystals are often assigned an effective refractive index defined by their dispersion relation. This index can predict their refractive properties consistent with Snell's law, but might not predict their dynamic properties in accordance with the Fresnel formulae.

articleTitle: Coherent resonant interactions with molecules in photonic band-gap fibers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that through use of an acetylene-filled hollow-core photonic band-gap fiber, coherent three-level spectroscopy can be performed and electromagnetically induced transparency can be observed using a molecular system with a weak optical response.

articleTitle: Ultrafast demagnetization in ferromagnetic InMnAs
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have studied demagnetization processes in ferromagnetic InMnAs induced by femtosecond mid-infrared laser pulses. At high pump fluences, complete magnetization quenching was observed within a few picoseconds, implying an ultrafast ferro- to paramagnetic phase transition.

articleTitle: Fourier analysis of plasmon polariton propagation in periodic structures of nanoholes
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fourier expansions are used to express the fields radiated from a thin gold film with periodic nanoholes. The polariton fields inside the nanoholes are analyzed. The optical transmission is calculated by imposing field boundary conditions.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Induced Instabilities for Contra-Directional Two-Beam Coupling in LiNbO3:Fe
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>:Fe, quasi-periodic instabilities are observed when recording photorefractive reflection gratings using a contra-directional two-beam coupling geometry. The mechanisms responsible for the noise and a technique used to eliminate these instabilities will be discussed

articleTitle: Femtosecond dynamics of ballistic charge current gratings in GaAs
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of ballistic charge currents, optically-injected into GaAs by quantum interference of 1550 and 775 nm, 150 fs pulses. Space-charge induced transport and ambipolar diffusion successively define the relaxation dynamics on a 500 fs-20 ps timescale.

articleTitle: Dissociation of ultracold molecules into atomic d waves
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the dissociation of ultracold molecules at a d-wave Feshbach resonance in /sup 87/Rb. Interference patterns between the outgoing atomic s and d waves are observed. The atomic d wave exhibits a shape resonance.

articleTitle: Coherent Light Scattering in Percolative Metallodielectric Nanoshells
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present results from linear light scattering experiments using percolative silver nanoshells on dielectric silica cores. Combining scaling theory with core-shell Mie scattering formalism we obtain a new model for the observed signals

articleTitle: Probing multiple excitons in CdSe nanoparticles by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the polarizability of electron-hole pairs quantum-confined in CdSe nanoparticles of 2-7 nm in diameter by the optical-pump/THz probe technique. The observed many-body effects are compared to self-consistent theoretical calculations.

articleTitle: Spectral redshifts in the intense laser-cluster interaction
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe, in spectrally resolved pump-probe laser-cluster interaction experiments, the occurrence of spectral redshifts consistent with rapidly increasing cluster polarizability early in the laser-heated cluster explosion

articleTitle: Pulse switching and stability in FM mode-locked fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of the pulse switching mechanism in FM mode-locked fiber lasers for what we believe to be the first time. Two completely different pulse switching mechanisms are identified.

articleTitle: Generation and detection of terahertz radiation by infrared ultrashort pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a terahertz generation and detection system with an infrared optical parametric amplifier as the light source, a poled electro-optic polymer film as the emitter, and a 1-mm-thick ZnTe as the sensor.

articleTitle: Cavity-QED-based quantum phase gates for a single longitudinal mode
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A three level atom and a longitudinal mode of a cavity can implement two-qubit quantum phase gates. The qubits are represented by the zero-and one-photon states of the two circular polarization states of the field.

articleTitle: Generation of an ultrabroadband optical pulse in a photonic crystal fiber by induced phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have experimentally generated an ultrabroadband pulse from 380 to 1000 nm in a photonic crystal fiber by induced phase modulation by use of a fundamental pulse and its second-harmonic pulse from a Ti:sapphire oscillator.

articleTitle: Deterministically controlled coupling of individual atoms to a high-finesse optical cavity
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum computing with atoms in optical cavities requires a precisely tunable atom-cavity coupling. This has now been achieved by means of a dipole-force trap transporting single atoms perpendicular to the cavity axis.

articleTitle: Completely characterizing ultrashort pulses using spectral interferometry at large crossing angles
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral interferometry ordinarily requires the interference of collinear beams. We measure the complete intensity and phase of pulses using collinear spectral interferometry by inserting a pinhole before the spectrometer, taking advantage of the diffracted beams.

articleTitle: True PMD emulation by the choice of free parameters in single polarization controller PMD emulator
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For the first time to our knowledge we demonstrate that simply using all free parameters of the single recirculating PC PMD emulator leads to near ideal statistical distribution, making it an instrument of choice.

articleTitle: Demonstration of first order gratings in titanium diffused waveguides on lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a first order low loss waveguide grating based on titanium diffused lithium niobate (LiNbO/sub 3/) waveguides. Reflectivity greater than 80% is achieved with a null-to-null bandwidth of 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Unravelling elementary non-radiative effects in nanocrystal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectrally resolved fluorescence decay measurements reveal a non-Auger like dependence of the photoluminescence decay rate with excitation density. Our results suggest that Auger recombination accelerates phonon assisted ionisation that lead to the formation of dark, non-emissive nanocrystal states.

articleTitle: Strong-coupling and nonlinear emission from a quantum-dot photonic-crystal-slab nanocavity
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An InAs quantum dot in a photonic crystal nanocavity exhibits vacuum Rabi splitting (strong coupling); a clear anti-crossing is seen between the quantum dot transition and the nanocavity mode as the temperature is scanned.

articleTitle: Side-pumped Hollow-core Fiber for Atom Guiding
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a side-pumping technique for high efficiency (>80%) light coupling into double-clad hollow-core optical fibers for evanescent wave atom-guiding. We examine the benefits of the scheme and techniques for optimizing atom throughput

articleTitle: Phonon dynamics in photoexcited bismuth
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The A1g phonon dynamics in photoexcited bismuth is presented. Simulations, using constrained DFT, and experiments, using double-pump-probe excitation of coherent phonons, separate the roles of lattice anharmonicity and plasma dynamics in the time-dependent vibrational period.

articleTitle: Gap solitons in nonlinear self-focusing metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Existence of gap solitons in metamaterials, exhibiting a self-focusing Kerr nonlinearity, is theoretically predicted. A nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation with a dispersive nonlinear term is derived from Maxwell's equations to study gap soliton stability

articleTitle: Sub-picosecond room temperature magneto-optical sampling with Cd/sub 1-x/Mn/sub x/Te
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the femtosecond Faraday effect in Cd/sub 0.88/Mn/sub 0.12/Te single crystals and its implementation in room-temperature magneto-optical sampling. Our technique is highly sensitive and capable of measuring sub-picosecond magnetic transients generated by a free-standing LT-GaAs photoswitch.

articleTitle: Design of 4/spl times/4 hard polymer clad fiber (HPCF) splitter for 2.5 Gbps short reach optical links
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel 4/spl times/4 Hard-Polymer-Clad-Fiber (HPCF) splitter was fabricated with a low loss and uniform power splitting ratio. 1/spl times/4 PON transmission of 1.25/2.5 Gbps at 850 nm over 50 m of HPCF was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Imaging of coherent polariton condensates
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The spatial distribution of a coherent polariton condensate is observed and compared to a theoretical model. A polarisation rotation in the parametric scattering process is found and the effect of different polarised condensates is studied.

articleTitle: Anomalous magneto-plasmonic spectra: evidence for stimulated emission or superradiance?
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel magneto-plasmonic emission phenomena are observed from excited Landau levels in In/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As quantum wells when pumped using intense femtosecond laser excitation in strong magnetic fields (25 T). The emission character is reminiscent of coherent spontaneous and stimulated emission.

articleTitle: Experimental evidence of wave packet splitting and adiabatic stabilization in an optical waveguide
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of wave packet dichotomy and adiabatic stabilization of light in a periodically-bent optical waveguide in analogy with similar behavior of atoms in high-frequency strong laser fields.

articleTitle: Coherent manipulation of quantum optical sideband modes
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a scheme for coherently rotating the quantum frequency sidebands of an optical field. Applications for this scheme may be found in discrete and continuous variable quantum information experiments.

articleTitle: Coupled charge-spin correlations in the pyrochlore Tl/sub 2/Mn/sub 2/O/sub 7/ probed by ultrafast mid-infrared spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An optical-pump, mid-infrared (IR)-probe system is used to investigate ultrafast temperature-dependent dynamics in the magnetoresistive pyrochlore Tl/sub 2/Mn/sub 2/O/sub 7/. We observe a prolonged carrier density increase, related to a scaling of the carrier lifetime with spin correlations.

articleTitle: Controlled spatiotemporal plasmon excitation of silver nanoparticles with chirped optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Numerical studies of chirped optical pulses interacting with cone-shaped silver nanoparticles are discussed. We show how localized excitations on the nanoparticles can be generated and controlled in a spatiotemporal manner and discuss a potential application.

articleTitle: Self-pumped Stimulated Backscattering and Six-wave Mixing in Fe:LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Conditions for self-pumped stimulated backscattering in Fe:LiNbO <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> are investigated. The degree of coherence in the stimulated backscattered light is determined through a novel interference experiment. The stimulated backscatter results from six-wave mixing inside the crystal

articleTitle: Pure single photon generation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a method of creating single photons in pure quantum states by parametric downconversion, along with the analysis of an experimental scheme for characterising their purity using multiple crystal interferometry.

articleTitle: Attosecond Optoelectronics in the Relativistic λ 3Regime
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Particle-in-cell simulations reveal that strong attosecond electromagnetic pulses and dense attosecond electron bunches emerge synchronously from laser-plasma interaction in the relativistic lambda <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> regime. This provides a basis for relativistic attosecond optoelectronics

articleTitle: Combined effects of Fabry-Perot and surface plasmon resonances in the terahertz time domain spectroscopy of plasmonic band gap structures
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using THz time-domain spectroscopy, we study plasmonic band gaps in periodic metal arrays of slits. Fabry-Perot effect enhances the transmission when the two resonances cross but does not alter the surface plasmon peak positions.

articleTitle: Spectral beam combining of a 980-nm laser array for EDFA pumping
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 980 nm laser source based on spectral beam combining is proposed for the pumping of EDFAs. A 1.5 W power is extracted from the laser cavity. Improvement of the EDFA gain flatness is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Coherence properties of supercontinuum generation in microstructure fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherence, spectral and temporal properties of the supercontinuum (SC) generation in microstructure fiber were experimentally studied by low peak-power femtosecond pump-pulses propagated in the anomalous and normal dispersion regions.

articleTitle: Quantum information processing with optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fiber-based sources of entangled photons offer some unique advantages over their crystal counterparts. We present our recent progress in the development of such sources and their applications in quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Broadband quantum generated one-time-pad encryption
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Clock recovery techniques at 1.25 Gbps and high-speed forward error correction and privacy amplification algorithms enable continuous one-time-pad encryption of a streaming video signal with quantum-generated key at rates above 1 Mbps.

articleTitle: Positive and negative band gaps, Rayleigh-Wood's anomalies in plasmonic band-gaps structures
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first measurement of blue shifted plasmonic bandgap structures. Issues concerning the Rayleigh wavelength, Wood's anomaly, surface plasmonic and Fabry-Perot resonances are clarified.

articleTitle: Excitation engineered pulse train generators
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Excitation-engineered pulse train repetition rate multipliers fabricated as a planar lightwave circuit are investigated. The overall temporal response is shown to be influenced by the design of both the splitter and combining regions.

articleTitle: Phase-shift effect on a two-dimensional surface-emitting photonic-crystal laser
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We analyzed the effect of a phase shift on a two-dimensional surface-emitting photonic crystal laser. It was shown that a single-lobed beam with linear polarization could be achieved for the crystal with elliptical air holes.

articleTitle: High-quality-factor AlGaAs optical microcavities for atomic Cs and semiconductor quantum dot cavity QED experiments
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-quality-factor (Q/spl sim/10/sup 4/-10/sup 5/) AlGaAs microdisks for atomic and semiconductor quantum dot cavity QED experiments are demonstrated. Cavities embedded with InAs/InGaAs dots-in-a-well exhibit room-temperature pulsed lasing with thresholds <17uW. Continuous wave operation at room-temperature is also observed.

articleTitle: Experimentally measuring the purity of a state without state tomography
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an experiment that determines the purity of a state without the need for state tomography. We rely instead on a Bell-basis measurement on a pair of particles.

articleTitle: Engineering spin-polarization dynamics in InGaAs dot-in-a-well (DWELL) structures
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Period of quantum beats in spin-polarization dynamics in DWELLS is shown to vary systematically with In concentration in the well. Spin-polarization in undoped and modulation-doped DWELLS is found to be very robust at high temperature.

articleTitle: Development of grazing-incidence focusing system for high-order harmonics in the soft X-ray region
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed grazing-incidence focusing system for high-order harmonics in soft X-ray region using Pt-coated ellipsoidal mirror. The practicability of mirror was confirmed by investigating characteristics for focused beam profile, reflectivity, and estimating focused intensity.

articleTitle: Enhanced quantum confined Stark effect in single core-shell semiconductor nanorods
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Elongated asymmetric core-shell CdSe/CdS nanocrystals allow direct engineering of the electron-hole wavefunction interaction. Besides controlling the spontaneous emission rate this promotes the quantum confined Stark effect, providing insight into surface charge diffusion in single nanocrystals.

articleTitle: Coherent phonons in a semiconductor superlattice studied by femtosecond X-ray diffraction
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For the first time femtosecond X-ray diffraction measures the coherent strain connected to a zone-folded longitudinal acoustic phonon optically excited in a GaAs/AlGaAs superlattice, giving direct evidence for the displacive excitation mechanism.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of time coding quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time coding quantum key distribution with coherent faint pulses is experimentally demonstrated. A measured 3.3% quantum bit error rate and a relative contrast loss of 8.4% allow a 0.49 bit/pulse advantage to Bob.

articleTitle: Effect of Beam Pointing Shift on the Carrier-envelope Phase Measurement using Self-referencing Spectral Interferometry Method
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured effects of beam pointing shift on the carrier-envelope phase measurement by self-referencing spectral interferometry method using hollow-core fibers or a sapphire plate for spectral broadening

articleTitle: Entangled and disentangled evolution for a single atom in a driven cavity
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For an atom in a driven cavity we find states that are highly entangled, and that spontaneous emission can transiently increase entanglement. We propose a correlation function measurement and discuss time evolution of entanglement.

articleTitle: Comparison between photonic crystal fiber and tapered fiber for pulse compression - toward mono-cycle optical pulses-
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A feedback system that combined modified-SPIDER and 4-f active-chirp compensation enabled us to compress photonic-crystal-fiber and tapered-fiber outputs to 5.8 and 8.4 fs, respectively. Advantages and problems of both fibers for further pulse compression were mentioned

articleTitle: Source of correlated photon pairs for quantum information using photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a bright, narrowband, polarized, single-mode, low-background source of correlated photon pairs in photonic crystal fibre, for quantum information applications. We detect 10/sup 5/ coincidences/s at wavelengths of 595 nm and 880 nm using silicon detectors.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength investigation of laser-induced defect reactions in KDP leading to enhanced damage resistance
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser annealing of defects to increase bulk laser-induced damage resistance of KDP/DKDP crystals is investigated for a wide range of laser parameters to reveal both the conditions necessary to optimize the effect and the underlying physical mechanisms.

articleTitle: Broadband optical circulators in two dimensional magneto-optical photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show strong magneto-optical hybridization and nonreciprocal characteristics in 2D bismuth-iron-garnet photonic crystal cavities induced by patterned magnetic domains. A Y-junction circulator is demonstrated numerically with a 20 dB bandwidth of 115 GHz at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Integrated optical functionalities featuring bi-periodic photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The results of a study on bi-periodic photonic crystal structures are presented. We show that not only straight waveguides, but also other optical functionalities can show significantly better performances, when bi-periodicity is introduced.

articleTitle: Generation of 1.8-ps mode-locked semiconductor optical amplifier fiber laser pulses by 60-ps backward optical dark comb injection
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Backward-optical-injection mode-locking of a semiconductor optical amplifier fiber laser with a 60-ps optical comb-like dark pulse-train is demonstrated with pulsewidth, linewidth and time-bandwidth product of 1.8 ps, 2.08 nm and 0.47, respectively, after dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Simultaneous spectral and temporal compression of femtosecond pulses in normally dispersive media
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral narrowing and pulse self-compression of high-intensity femtosecond pulses are experimentally studied in normally dispersive media. Shorter than Gaussian or sech/sup 2/ transform-limited self-compression femtosecond pulses are obtained. Spectral red-shift is observed in the experiment.

articleTitle: Single molecule imaging using a highly confined optical field at a triangular aperture
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that scanning near-field optical microscopy based on a probe with a triangular aperture is capable of imaging single fluorescent molecules with an optical resolution of 30 nm. Numerical simulations agree well with experiment.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic properties of all-ceramic composite with layer-by-layer of Nd:Y/sub 3/Al/sub 5/O/sub 12/ and Nd:Y/sub 3/ScAl/sub 4/O/sub 12/
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have fabricated the all-ceramic layered composite of Nd:YAG and Nd:Y/sub 3/ScAl/sub 4/O/sub 12/, and investigated spectroscopic properties. Solid-solution based composite technology can provide the designing of spectral profiles and will produce the complex function.

articleTitle: Optical properties of planar metallo-dielectric photonic crystal superlattices
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study experimentally and theoretically the influence of the superperiod on the transmission properties of metallic photonic crystals slabs. We found that additional modes couple to the plasmon resonances, leading to a strongly modified spectrum.

articleTitle: Destabilization by noise of passive mode locking with general dispersion and Kerr nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study passive mode-locking in the general case of arbitrary dispersion and Kerr nonlinearity and the presence of noise. We present an analytical derivation and expressions for the threshold power required to maintain mode-locked pulses.

articleTitle: Bit error ratio improvement by two transfer function regenerators
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that an optical regenerator can improve the BER only if it has different power transfer functions for the logical ones and logical zeros. Regenerators that filter SPM spectral broadening provide such transfer functions.

articleTitle: Nonlinear upconversion interferometry
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the phase coherence of the upconversion process by upconverting time-bin states produced using two unbalanced Michelson interferometers.

articleTitle: Extraordinary terahertz transmission of elliptical subwavelength hole array
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present extraordinary terahertz transmission of an elliptical subwavelength hole array patterned on ultrathin, highly doped silicon. The measured transmission peak frequency shows strong dependence on the surrounding materials.

articleTitle: Investigation of linewidth enhancement factor variations in external cavity and Fabry-Perot semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The /spl alpha/-factor is measured using the self-mixing technique. For an ECL laser, /spl alpha/ varies between 2 and 5, and the linewidth changes accordingly. Dependence of /spl alpha/ on emitted power is investigated for a FP laser.

articleTitle: Controlled energy transfer between two nano emitters via shared high-Q optical modes in a microsphere resonator
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an experiment where a single nanoparticle can be coupled under controlled conditions to the high-Q modes of a microsphere resonator. These modes are then used to mediate an energy transfer between two nanoparticles.

articleTitle: State tomography in the presence of inaccessible information
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polarization state tomography has been done on a system of two photons that could not be individually addressed experimentally. We show how polarization correlation measurements can reveal indirect information about experimentally inaccessible degrees of freedom.

articleTitle: Nonlinear-optical spectral transformations of a two-color short-pulse laser field in a photonic-crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond pulses of fundamental Cr: forsterite laser radiation are used as a pump field to tune the frequency and transform the spectrum of copropagating second-harmonic pulses of the same laser through cross-phase modulation and cross-modulation-induced instability in a photonic-crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Conical Emission from Sodium Vapor Excited with Femtosecond Light Pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two distinct types of the cones, red-shifted in respect to the single-photon sodium transition 3S-3P have been registered simultaneously for the pump wavelength tuned between 540 and 585 nm. Parametric four-photon superfluorescence was also detected

articleTitle: Demonstration of a desk-top size 46.9 nm laser at 12 Hz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of a desktop-size high repetition rate extreme ultraviolet laser. Laser pulses at /spl lambda/=46.9 nm with energy /spl sim/13 /spl mu/J were generated at 12 Hz repetition rate by single pass amplification in a Ne-like Ar capillary discharge plasma column.

articleTitle: Chaotic Behaviors in Three-Level Atomic Optical Bistability System
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated chaotic behaviors in three-level Lambda-type atoms inside an optical cavity. The route to chaos through periodic doubling was observed in the experiment, which could be controlled by the coupling beam parameters.

articleTitle: Optical-field-ionization EUV lasing in a xenon cluster jet
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An optical-field-ionization EUV laser with prepulse-controlled nanoplasma expansion in a cluster gas jet was demonstrated. Pd-like xenon lasing at 41.8-nm with 100 nJ/pulse and 5-mrad divergence was achieved, indicating near-saturation amplification.

articleTitle: Strong light confinement in novel compact pseudo-random structures designed via evolutionary algorithms
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High optical confinement of 1.55 /spl mu/n light is shown in a 5 /spl mu/m sized high-index-contrast pseudo-random distribution of dielectric rods. This structure, designed using Evolutionary Algorithms, utilizes Anderson Localization to achieve confinement.

articleTitle: Line shape analysis of single excitons and trions in CdSe nanorods
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the fine structure and line shape of neutral and charged excitons in single CdSe nanorods by polarization and power-sensitive micro-photoluminescence spectroscopy and compare the exciton ground state symmetry in nanorods and spherical nanocrystals.

articleTitle: Time-resolved X-ray absorption fine structure measurement of laser-melted Si with femtosecond laser-produced-plasma X-ray source
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the picosecond time-resolved measurement of the X-ray absorption fine structure in laser-melted Si by using a femtosecond laser-produced-plasma soft X-ray source and report that the Si-Si atomic distance broadened due to the melting.

articleTitle: Harmonic generation from boron plasma
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of the 63/sup rd/ harmonic of a Ti:sapphire laser pulse from boron plasma. Typical conversion efficiencies were evaluated to be between 10/sup -4/ (for third harmonic) and 10/sup -7/ (within the plateau range).

articleTitle: Secure quantum key distribution (QKD) over 76 km of optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe our recent experiments on one-way QKD in optical fibers. We used both, weak coherent pulses (WCP) as well as a heralded single photon source based on parametric down conversion of CW light.

articleTitle: LIGO interferometry
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Interferometric gravitational wave antennas are based on enhanced Michelson interferometers. The sensitivity goal of the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-wave Observatory (LIGO) is 10/sup -21/ rms, integrated over a 100 Hz bandwidth centered at 150 Hz. The use of Fabry-Perot cavities is essential for reaching the required sensitivity, but sets challenges for the control system which must maintain the cavities near resonance. We present the major design features of the LIGO length and frequency sensing and control system which will hold the differential length to within 5/spl times/10/sup -14/ m of the operating point. We also highlight the restrictions imposed by couplings of noise into the gravitational wave readout signal and the required immunity against them.

articleTitle: Sub-nanojoule pulse compression down to 6 fs in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A photonic crystal fiber with zero dispersion wavelength of 861 nm is used for pulse compression of sub-nanojoule laser pulses. Theory shows that sub-6 fs pulses can be generated using a 6 mm long fiber

articleTitle: Single-photon two-qubit entangled states: preparation and measurement
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We implement experimentally a deterministic method to prepare and measure single-photon two-qubit entangled states, in which the polarization and the spatial modes of a single-photon each represent a quantum bit. All four single-photon Bell-states can be easily prepared and measured deterministically using linear optical elements alone.

articleTitle: Optical vortices in quasi-periodic optical lattices
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate methods for manipulating individual sites in optical lattices that enable the creation of defects within otherwise periodic light patterns. The modified optical lattice is created by interference of plane and spiral waves.

articleTitle: Disorder-induced optical scattering loss in planar photonic crystal waveguides: theory and experiment
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We directly compare a photon Green function theory of extrinsic optical scattering loss in planar-photonic-crystal waveguides with state-of-the-art measurements. The calculations successfully explain the strongly dispersive disorder-induced loss measurements over broadband frequencies.

articleTitle: Nanoplasmonic approach to strongly anisotropic optical materials
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present several nanoplasmonic composites, having strong anisotropy of dielectric constant at optical frequencies, and develop the corresponding theory. The proposed applications include low-loss optical negative-n materials, filters, and polarizers

articleTitle: Mode compression and loss in tapered microstructure optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We calculate the evolution of the loss, dispersion, and mode shape in a tapered microstructure optical fiber. We show that the primary limitation on mode compression is the loss due to mode leakage.

articleTitle: Suppression of parasitic lasing in large-aperture Ti:sapphire amplifiers. Amplifying strategies for high rep-rate petawatt class Ti:sapphire systems
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have studied experimentally and theoretically the parasitic lasing phenomenon in large-aperture Ti:sapphire crystals to optimize the amplification scheme of petawatt class Ti:sapphire laser. Simulations, first experimental results and strategy of amplification will be presented.

articleTitle: Nearfield investigation of mode structure in photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We studied light propagation inside photonic crystal waveguides by nearfield scanning optical microscope. Amplitude and phase distributions were mapped for straight and bent waveguides, characteristic modes for different wavelengths and their periodic interchange were observed.

articleTitle: Deep blue generation at 456 nm in a periodically poled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ ridge-type waveguide by single-pass frequency doubling of a Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ micro-laser
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Continuous-wave blue light at 456 nm of 93 mW with 14.6% infrared-to-blue conversion efficiency (17.3% internal conversion) is reported from a periodically polled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ ridge-type waveguide by single-pass frequency doubling of a 912-nm Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ micro-laser.

articleTitle: Broadband terahertz pulse propagation in strongly scattering random media
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on studies of terahertz pulse propagation in strongly scattering random media. The experimental delay, pulse distortion, spectral decay, and power attenuation are in excellent agreement with predictions from a Monte Carlo model.

articleTitle: Imperfect mitigation of dispersion induced power penalty in high power single-sideband modulated radio-on-fiber links
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the transmission of radio-on-fiber link employing single-sideband modulation (SSB) under the combined effects of fiber loss, nonlinearity and dispersion. Results show that dispersion-induced power penalty still exists in high-power SSB modulated links.

articleTitle: Broadband microwave frequency upshifting technique based on a general temporal Talbot effect in fibers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A microwave frequency upshifting technique based on a general temporal Talbot effect in fiber is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. This technique is ideally suited for broadband arbitrary waveform generation only limited by the photodetector bandwidth.

articleTitle: Improved performance of top-emitting, oxide-confined VCSELs with self-aligned contact and Cu-plated heatsink
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) with a self-aligned top contact and copper-plated heatsink were fabricated and characterized. Thermal resistance was reduced by 44%, and output power and bandwidth were increased by 38% and 12% respectively.

articleTitle: Approaches to compact quantum cascade laser modules with integrated coolers
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A compact quantum cascade laser module is presented. That is based on conductive as well as convective cooling for efficient heat dissipation. Quantum cascade lasers with selectively doped active regions achieve better thermal behavior.

articleTitle: Performance of nonlinear photonic crystal devices at high bit rates
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate theoretically the performance limits for nonlinear all-optical switching devices incorporating photonic crystals. Due to dispersion significant performance enhancement are achieved only in materials combining high nonlinearity, high index contrast and high damage threshold.

articleTitle: Lasing action in the transition from localized to diffusive modes in random arrays of cylinders
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the transition from localized to extended modes when size dispersion is introduced into random collections of resonant cylinders. When gain is introduced, we compare random lasing action in both localized and diffusive samples.

articleTitle: Polarization controlled parametric oscillation in quasi-one-dimensional microcavities
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Parametric polariton scattering is studied in quasi-one-dimensional microcavities. Polarization splittings on the order of the polariton linewidth give rise to polarization selective parametric scattering. We demonstrate the inversion of linear polarization via parametric oscillation.

articleTitle: Biexciton polariton laser emission in a GaAs microcavity
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Biexciton polariton emission from GaAs SQW microcavity were observed at 10K. This mode appear 0.27 meV blueshifted from the lower polariton branch, showing a laser like behavior, and also crossed polarizations for this double mode.

articleTitle: Lasing in the random medium of colloidal CdS/CdSe/CdS quantum-well structure
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lasing action is observed in random medium of colloidal CdS/CdSe/CdS quantum-well structure. The lasing threshold is much lower and the lasing linewidth is much narrower than that of other random or nanocrystal laser systems.

articleTitle: Semi-Discrete Solitons in Arrays of Quadraticall Nonlinear Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time that an array of discrete waveguides on a slab waveguide, both with quadratic nonlinearity, supports stable localized composite solitons consisting of discrete solitons coupled to continuous slab waveguide solitons

articleTitle: Efficient 13.5 nm EUV generation from a laser plasma
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a source of 13.5 nm radiation, based on multi-kHz laser-plasmas created from tin-bearing micro-droplets that has a high probability of satisfying the requirements for EUVL, the next generation lithography for computer chip fabrication.

articleTitle: Two-and Three photon excited fluorescence in Y-shaped molecules
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two- and three-photon excited fluorescence and its optimization via pulse shaping was studied in a novel classes of Y-shaped chromophores with large nonlinera absorption cross section.

articleTitle: Selective high-order harmonic generation by filamentation in various gases
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Selective high-order harmonic generation by filamentation of an intense laser pulse in various gases is demonstrated and depending on gas choice and pressure, wavelength-dependent enhancement and extinction of specific harmonics is observed.

articleTitle: Single-polarized Zn-diffused optical switch on a y-cut LiNbO/sub 3/
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A single-polarized Zn-diffused 1/spl times/2 optical switch of 1.55 /spl mu/m wavelength is demonstrated on a y-cut LiNbO/sub 3/ substrate for the first time. It shows that the Zn indiffusion process can make a well single extraordinary polarization waveguide with non-degraded electrooptic properties.

articleTitle: Time-resolved spectroscopy of single excitons bound to Te isoelectronic pairs in ZnSe
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Single Te pairs in ZnSe:Te were probed using time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy. While the bright exciton states consist of a linearly polarized doublet, the dark states are manifested in a biexponential luminescence decay.

articleTitle: Detection of ultrahigh frequency acoustic transients using coherent EUV light
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrahigh-frequency narrow-band surface acoustic waves are detected using diffraction of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light from a laser-generate transient grating. Initial experiments have probed surface periodicities as small as 750 nm, with corresponding acoustic frequencies of 4.7 GHz.

articleTitle: Quadrupolar SHG enhancement in isotropic materials using two orthogonally polarized laser beams
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an experimental technique to isolate and enhance quadrupolar SHG in isotropic materials using two orthogonally polarized laser beams that create wavelength-scale, forward-radiating gradients in the second-harmonic polarization.

articleTitle: High power stabilized lasers and optics of GW detectors
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Initial LIGO is approaching its target performance and the design of advanced LIGO is near completion. A report on the progress on lasers and optics for initial LIGO and advanced LIGO is presented.

articleTitle: Evaluation of zero-dispersion wavelength and negative group-delay dispersion in microstructured fibers from Wigner distribution function analysis of nonlinear propagated few-optical-cycle pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using Wigner distribution functions, the time-frequency evolving mechanism of few-optical-cycle pulses nonlinearly propagated in microstructured fibers and their phase compensation by a 4-f phase compensator was analyzed. Evaluated negative dispersion of tapered-fiber-waist agreed with calculation

articleTitle: Observation of correlated-photon statistics using a single detector
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an experimental observation of correlated-photon statistics using a single detector. The usual coincidence dip in a two-photon polarization interferometer is accompanied by a dip in single-photon detection rates. Surprisingly, a dip in the singles rate is also observed when the interferometer is aligned for a coincidence peak, or anti-dip. This effect is explained by taking into account all possible photon number states that reach the detector, rather than considering just the state post-selected by the coincidence measurement.

articleTitle: Microscopic model of electronic Kerr effect in strong electric fields of intense femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast electronic Kerr non-linearity in bulk dielectrics is described by the dynamic Franz-Keldysh effect, corresponding to dynamic coherent renormalization of their bandgaps in strong electrical fields of intense IR or visible femtosecond laser pulses

articleTitle: Optically induced perturbations of photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond pump-probe experiments are used to demonstrate how the optical tuning of a photonic crystal can depend on which eigenmode is excited. A simple, general perturbation formalism accounts for the results.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal device sensitivity analysis and optimization with Wannier basis gradients
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a powerful photonic crystal device sensitivity analysis and optimization method utilizing efficient matrix techniques. We optimize the performance of a compact (8.2/spl times/13.3 /spl mu/m) waveguide mode demux with the method. FDTD simulations validated the design.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of true left-handed metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a true left-handed (LH) behavior in composite metamaterials. The magnetic resonance of the SRR structure is demonstrated. Plasma frequency of the LH material is shown to be lower than that of the wires

articleTitle: Guiding of light in an ultracold, anisotropic medium
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Guiding of a weak probe beam in an ultracold, anisotropic medium is demonstrated. The guide can be tuned by dressing the atoms with a strong pump. This medium is also used to realize a fast, all-optical switch.

articleTitle: The spatial Zeno effect applied to atomic optics
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The scattering of waves at a ridged surface is interpreted as the Zeno effect. This interpretation leads to a simple estimate for the coefficient of reflection. Our estimate shows good agreement with experimental data.

articleTitle: High resolution subsurface thermal imaging using a numerical aperture increasing lens
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the experimental limitations of the maximum resolution that can be achieved in far-field subsurface thermal imaging with a numerical aperture increasing lens- High-resolution thermal imaging has applications in failure analysis of Si integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Incoherent blocker soliton interactions in Kerr waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed the incoherent interaction between a highly confined soliton and a wide, moving beam of different wavelength in an AlGaAs waveguide array. Digital switching of the blocker solitons to adjacent channels was observed.

articleTitle: Generation of frequency tunable nano-acoustic waves by optical coherent control
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated an optical coherent control technique to generate nano-acoustic waves in InGaN single-quantum-well with tunable acoustic frequency. The acoustic phonon lifetime of the generated nano-acoustic wave was also measured.

articleTitle: Analysis of transmission and reflection spectra of three-dimensional photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use numerical simulations based on a scattering-matrix formalism to investigate the influence of diffracted orders on transmission and reflection spectra of photonic crystal samples.

articleTitle: Performance degradation induced by pulse carver/data modulator misalignment in RZ-DPSK systems
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The impacts of the distortion induced by pulse carver/data modulator misalignment on the performance of RZ-DPSK systems are investigated. Such distortion can be generalized as intersymbol interference and strongly depends on input data pulse shape.

articleTitle: Pseudorandom binary pulse shaping in femtosecond laser spectroscopy and imaging
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multiphoton spectroscopy and functional imaging using a 10-fs laser pulse with binary (0 or /spl pi/) phase shaping are demonstrated. Theoretical and experimental considerations of pseudorandom Galoise fields to control multiphoton intrapulse interference are presented.

articleTitle: Transients in polymer photoconductive devices
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High speed transients in MEH-PPV polymer devices have been investigated. Photoconductive carrier lifetime of 0.9 picoseconds was observed. Transient carrier mobility lower limit of 800 cm/sup 2//Vs was estimated. Measurement of photoinduced change in reflectivity of MEH-PPV has been initiated.

articleTitle: Superfocusing of Light Beams below the Diffraction Limit by Photonic Crystals with Negative Refraction
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that photonic crystal with negative refraction amplifying the evanescent waves, combined with an aperture creating seed evanescent components, can focus light beams below the diffraction limit of half of the wavelength

articleTitle: Nonlinear absorption and dispersion in fiber coupled silicon photonic crystal microresonators
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-photon absorption, free-carrier absorption and dispersion, and thermo-optic dispersion in high-Q, ultra-small mode volume, photonic crystal cavities are studied experimentally. Sub-nanosecond free-carrier lifetimes, and optical bistability at /spl sim/ 100/spl mu/W cavity input power are observed.

articleTitle: Anti-Stokes GaAs random laser
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate first anti-Stokes solid-state laser in which only one pumping photon is required to produce one higher-energy emission photon. The difference of energy is drawn from phonons. This regime is realized in GaAs random laser.

articleTitle: Shaped laser pulses acting as photonic reagents
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Shaped ultrafast laser pulses acting as photonic reagents are used to manipulate a broad variety of quantum dynamics phenomenon. The principles involved are discussed including the prospects for the future use of photonic reagents.

articleTitle: Optimization of lasing in semiconductor micro-stadiums
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We studied experimentally and numerically how the cavity shape affects the lasing frequency and lasing threshold in semiconductor micro-stadiums. We found there exist optimal deformations at which the lasing threshold is minimized.

articleTitle: Nano-scale imaging with a compact EUV laser
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report sub-140 nm resolution imaging with 46.9 nm radiation from a compact capillary-discharge laser. This result was obtained using a combination of a Sc/Si multilayer-coated Schwarzschild condenser and free-standing imaging zone plate.

articleTitle: Effective Multi-photon Induced Stimulated Emission
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Up-converted amplified spontaneous emission by direct four-photon excitation is observed in organic molecular solution; and their efficiencies of up-conversion stimulated emission by direct three-photon excitation up to half of those by two-photon excitation are detected

articleTitle: Generation of frequency-sheared XUV pulses by high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Frequency-sheared and time-separated high harmonics were produced without spatial separation in the target gas by controlling the time-frequency properties of the driving field. Simulations show good agreement within the strong-field approximation.

articleTitle: Gravitational waves: from astrophysics to optics
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Gravitational waves, predicted by Einstein's general theory of relativity, will be a unique probe of violent astrophysical events. The precision measurement challenges and successes for interferometric detectors, now starting to observe, take optics to extremes.

articleTitle: Phase critical-energy in second harmonic generation from thermally oxidized Si(001) interfaces
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The rotational-anisotropy second-harmonic generation signal from thermally oxidized Si(001) surfaces shows unusual eightfold symmetry at a critical photon energy. This phase critical-energy varies monotonically with oxide thickness and provides a sensitive probe for interface conditions.

articleTitle: The GEO600 gravitational wave detector
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The GEO600 laser interferometric gravitational wave detector is unique in having advanced monolithic suspensions and a signal recycled optical design. This contribution will discuss the optical layout, the heterodyne readout and the performance of GEO600.

articleTitle: Monomolecular hybrid angular momentum wavepacket versus molecular orientation undeterminism
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The quantized rotational structure of the molecule converts the intrinsic energy-uncertainty of a fs optical laser pulse into an integer number of unit angular momenta which interfere as the ion-core rotates and oscillate between a pure orbital and a pure linear momentum state.

articleTitle: Optical Biopsy of Human Skin with Backward-Collected Optical Harmonics Signals
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Combining backward-collected second- and third-harmonic signals, noninvasive optical biopsy of human skin is demonstrated. With backward collection geometry and energy-conservation characteristic of harmonic generations, this technique is ideal for future noninvasive clinical skin disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: Modelling quantum-dot in quasi-3D photonic crystal defect microcavity for single-photon sources
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We model wavelength scale III-V photonic crystal defect microcavities containing a single quantum-dot using 3-D FDTD. These microcavities have small modal volume while maintaining high Q-factors to make efficient single-photon sources for quantum information applications.

articleTitle: Resolution Limits of a Negative Refractive Index Lens
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The influence of loss in a negative refractive index slab is described using a plane wave expansion. Sensitivity of the decaying fields to small loss has an adverse impact on resolution

articleTitle: Laser cooling in a feedback-controlled optical shaker
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical shaking with feedback is proposed as a new method for laser cooling of atoms and molecules to high phase-space density and without the loss of particles typical of evaporative cooling.

articleTitle: All-fiber, single-stage laser assemblies with 91 W single-mode, continuous-wave output power
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on all-fiber single-stage laser assemblies with up to 91 W of output power and 66.5% slope efficiency. Three different configurations combine the advantages of large-mode-area gain fibers and single-mode output fibers.

articleTitle: Enhancement of nonlinear interactions due to the light localization phenomena in porous GaP
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a more than an order of magnitude enhancement of the second-harmonic and Raman scattering intensities in porous GaP in comparison with crystalline GaP; the effects correlate with a rise of photon diffusion time.

articleTitle: Migration-assisted upconversion in high-concentration EDFA with electronic feed-forward gain control
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Accounting for statistical nature of migration and upconversion, we develop a new model of high-concentration EDFA with an electronic feed-forward gain control. Unlike homogeneous upconversion model, this model shows complete agreement with experimental data.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic localization in photonic crystals without defects
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study theoretically, using an effective mass approach, out-of-plane three-dimensional wave localization in two-dimensional photonic crystals without defects. Existence of hyperbolic localization (X-waves) in stationary regime is analytically proved and confirmed numerically.

articleTitle: Characterization and scanning probe spectroscopy of radiation-pressure induced mechanical oscillation of a microcavity
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Microcavities can enter a regime where radiation pressure causes oscillation of mechanical cavity eigenmodes. We present a detailed experimental and theoretical understanding of this effect, and report direct scanning probe spectroscopy of the micro-mechanical modes.

articleTitle: Mid- IR laser transitions in Nd/sup 3+/ doped CaGa/sub 2/S/sub 4/, PbGa/sub 2/S/sub 4/, and PbCl/sub 2/ laser crystals
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multiphonon and radiative relaxation of mid-IR laser transitions is analyzed in neodymium doped calcium and lead thiogallates and lead chloride laser crystals. Higher radiative and much lower nonradiative rates are found comparing to fluorides.

articleTitle: Incoherent spatial solitons in nematic liquid crystals
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We obtain analytical solutions describing spatially incoherent soliton beams in nematic liquid crystal cells. The effects arising from non-locality on the coherence properties of these self-trapped states are systematically investigated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Ce/sup 3+/:LiCaAlF/sub 6/ crystals as a solid-state ultraviolet saturable absorber and role of excited state absorption
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using open-aperture Z-scan method and a Q-switch Nd:YAG laser, saturation properties of Ce/sup 3+/:LiCaAlF/sub 6/ crystals at wavelength of 266 nm are studied. Saturable absorption of solid-state materials in ultraviolet region is demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Electro-optic probe based on an unbalanced AlGaAs/GaAs microresonator
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider the electro-optic effect in an unbalanced AlGaAs/GaAs Fabry-Perot resonator. The resonator structure allows simultaneous enhancement of the electro-optic effect and the total reflectance. These properties are essential for development of a miniature electro-optic probe. We demonstrate and characterize a compact 3.31 /spl mu/m long electro-optic probe based on the unbalanced AlGaAs/GaAs microresonator.

articleTitle: Quantum imaging of nonlocal spatial correlations in parametric down-conversion induced by the pump-beam profile
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a quantum imaging method wherein the quantum image obtained through coincidence counting is dependent on the pump-beam profile. Quantum nature of the nonlocal spatial correlations are experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Coupled-ring reflector and its application to widely tunable laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A coupled-ring reflector (CRR), which is composed of two coupled rings coupled with a straight waveguide, is proposed. Its reflection property is analyzed and its applicability to a widely tunable laser diode is discussed.

articleTitle: A WDM channel selectable diode laser with a mode-hop-free fine-tuning mechanism
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A liquid crystal pixel mirror allows digitally tuning of an external cavity laser to more than 40 channels of 100 GHz spacing. Laser wavelength can further be fine-tuned over 1.89 GHz by a phase plate.

articleTitle: Stimulated Raman Scattering and Compression of Chirped TW Laser Pulses for Two-Color High Intensity Experiments
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Generation of a Stokes shifted SRS ultrafast laser pulse is described. A Raman shifter, Ba(NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, inserted inside a CPA system generates pulses at any of the Stokes or anti-Stokes wavelengths without SPM

articleTitle: Formation of stable ultracold molecules by photoassociation with chirped laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate photoassociation of ultracold atoms, such as Cs(6s), with chirped laser pulses in the ps range. Numerical calculations are analyzed, demonstrating efficient population inversion within a photoassociation window. Stabilization of the photoassociated molecules into bound levels of the ground state is discussed. Ongoing work on photoassociation of rubidium with femtosecond pulses will be presented at the conference.

articleTitle: Optically injected AC spin currents based on excitonic quantum interference in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show theoretically how spin-polarized and pure spin AC currents can be optically injected in semiconductors via quantum interference between excitonic 1s and 2p states. The electrical current may be observed by its THz radiation.

articleTitle: Modification of Nonlinear Susceptibilities in Anisotropically Nanostructured Silicon
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The cubic susceptibility tensor properties in porous silicon with strong in-plane birefringence caused by form anisotropy is considered. Polarization-sensitive third-harmonic generation in such media reveals a modification in the cubic susceptibility tensor.

articleTitle: Generation of XUV supercontinuum and single attosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: XUV supercontinuum covering 30-100 eV was generated by polarization gating of the high-order harmonic process using 8 fs laser pulses. Analysis of the spectrum indicates that it corresponds to a single attosecond pulse.

articleTitle: Tunable propagation delay of femtosecond pulses in a quantum-dot optical amplifier at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optically induced dispersion over a large bandwidth of 2.6 THz is used to slow or speed up a 150 fs pulse in a quantum-dot optical amplifier. A group refractive index change of 4*10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> is observed

articleTitle: Third-harmonic generation from Rayleigh particles: breaking all the rules
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time both theoretically and experimentally that the power of the third-harmonic generated by a Rayleigh particle is scaled as the fourth power of its radius.

articleTitle: Virgo: a wide band gravitational wave detector
publicationTitle: 2005 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
